POR QUE OS EVANGÉLICOS SÃO IMPORTANTES Os evangélicos brancos representam cerca de 13% dos adultos dos EUA, mas quase um terço da coalizão vencedora de Trump em 2024, de acordo com uma pesquisa do PRRI e uma análise de eleitores validados realizada pelo Pew Research Center, uma instituição apartidária. Mais de 80% votaram em Trump em cada uma de suas três campanhas presidenciais, segundo o Pew. Eles diferem acentuadamente dos evangélicos protestantes negros, que apoiam de forma esmagadora os democratas. A lealdade dos evangélicos também pode se mostrar decisiva nas disputas pelo Senado fora da Carolina do Sul, que podem ajudar a determinar o controle do Congresso, inclusive em Iowa e no Kansas, onde os evangélicos brancos representam uma parcela significativa do eleitorado. Pesquisas de opinião sugerem que a disputa na Carolina do Sul está acirrada. Nesta semana, o Trafalgar Group, uma empresa de pesquisa com tendência republicana, divulgou uma pesquisa mostrando Andrews 3 pontos percentuais atrás de Graham. Parte do desafio de Graham decorre do mal-estar persistente entre alguns conservadores em relação à sua indicação para a vaga no Senado. Mesmo após receber o apoio de Trump, a novata na política derrotou por uma margem estreita o deputado federal Ralph Norman no segundo turno do partido, em agosto, o que reforçou as dúvidas de alguns republicanos sobre sua experiência e suas credenciais conservadoras. Um porta-voz da campanha de Graham não respondeu a um pedido de comentário. No entanto, mesmo evangélicos pouco entusiasmados com Graham, como Kevin Thomas, de 53 anos, disseram sentir que tinham poucas opções. Thomas, que participou do sermão na Village Church e apoiou Norman, afirmou que, mesmo assim, não confiava em Andrews em questões relacionadas a pessoas transgênero. “Estou inclinado a tapar o nariz e votar em Graham”, disse Thomas. “Não estou disposto a sacrificar seis anos tendo uma democrata nos representando na Carolina do Sul.”

item.title: French bond pain puts euro zone's weak links on notice
item.description: As a selloff in French government bonds deepens, the region's debt-laden economies risk a surge in borrowing costs while also grappling with increasing social unrest.
item.dc:creator: Amanda Cooper, Dhara Ranasinghe
item.content:encoded: As a selloff in French government bonds deepens, the region's debt-laden economies risk a surge in borrowing costs while also grappling with increasing social unrest. French 10-year bond yields on Thursday hit a [USN:L6N4680QK TEXT:"fresh 24-year high above 5%"], driving their premium over benchmark German Bunds to nearly 180 basis points , or 1.8%, the most since the depths of the euro zone debt crisis in 2011. A huge fiscal deficit that has been complicated by political stalemate in Paris and the [USN:L6N4680S7 TEXT:"worst civil unrest in years"] are the latest catalysts. As France has come under strain, investors are turning up the heat on the likes of Italy, Belgium and even Greece. Similar to France, students took to the streets in Belgium at the weekend to protest against high housing costs, while Italy has also faced protests. Italian yields have risen 14 bps this week to 4.616%, not far off early October's three-year highs. The premium Belgium pays to borrow over 10 years relative to Germany rose to its highest in 14 years at 109 bps . "Markets look ahead and they say 'well, if borrowing costs stay this high, then eventually you're going to have to refinance at higher rates'," said Mike Bell, head of market strategy at BlueBay Asset Management. While he does not expect the gap between French and German bond yields to get as wide as those of Italy and Spain against Germany during the euro debt crisis, which hit 6% and 5% then, respectively, it could exceed 2%. Bell said concern that French politicians would shy away from taking the necessary steps to put France on a sustainable debt path, especially given the protests, could heighten pressure. TAKE OUT SOME INSURANCE Belgium's debt yields have risen steadily this year along with those elsewhere given rising energy prices, but that rise has accelerated. Its 10-year borrowing costs rose by as much as 12 bps on Thursday to 4.54%, the highest since early 2012. Highlighting the unease, the cost of insuring against the risk of default for Belgium hit its highest since April 2020 on Thursday at nearly 39 basis points. This is well below the levels logged during the euro zone debt crisis in 2012, but the speed at which Belgian CDS have risen rivals that of France, with both having more than doubled in the last month. "Belgium's had a lot of debt for a long time," Chris Scicluna, head of research at Daiwa Capital Markets, said. "It obviously has a history of political paralysis and government paralysis and if you've got a deficit that needs to be reduced, sadly, over the years, that's not helpful," he said. "So, it does tick a lot of the boxes that should leave investors uneasy, but certainly, it's not France." Italian bonds have performed strongly in recent years, bringing their yields below those of France last September for the first time since the debt crisis. They, too, are back in the spotlight. An election next year [USN:L8N45Z1S1 TEXT:"throws doubt on Rome's"] plans to reverse the rise in its huge public debt, analysts say. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni approved tough anti-riot measures after unrest swept northern Italian cities at the weekend, including [USN:L8N4661X4 TEXT:"financial capital Milan"]. "Fuel prices, widespread cost-of-living pressures and housing prices continue to top the list of grievances, underlining the point that while many developed economies continue to show considerable resilience, there is little or no 'feel-good factor' for the majority of the public at large," ASM Investor Services global economist Marc Ostwald said.

item.title: Former Euroleague CEO warns clubs against surrendering control to NBA
item.description: Former Euroleague CEO Jordi Bertomeu told Reuters on Thursday that the competition's clubs should not give up control over their future in any collaboration with the NBA's planned European league.
item.dc:creator: Ruairidh Barlow
item.content:encoded: Former Euroleague CEO Jordi Bertomeu told Reuters on Thursday that the competition's clubs should not give up control over their future in any collaboration with the NBA's planned European league. The NBA is targeting October 2027 for the launch of NBA Europe, while Euroleague plans to expand its competition for the 2027-28 season. Euroleague CEO Chus Bueno told Reuters on Monday that further fragmentation of European basketball would be "[USN:L6N4650V6 TEXT:"a disaster"]", although both sides say they remain open to working together. Bertomeu told Reuters that collaboration was in everyone's interests, but the NBA's current offer was not attractive to Euroleague. Euroleague's 13 shareholder clubs collectively own and govern the competition, giving them a say over its format, financial model and strategic direction. The NBA proposal has not been made public, but Bertomeu said its terms "as they are being presented today are not those of a collaboration, based on what we know." The Euroleague shareholders rejected the proposal at a meeting on October 6. Earlier this month a senior executive at a Euroleague club told Reuters that they expected the NBA to come back with an improved offer. Euroleague and NBA Europe have both promised growth for the 13 Euroleague shareholder clubs. Bueno says most Euroleague clubs would be sustainable within five years under its [USN:L6N4620ST TEXT:"10-year business plan"], while NBA Deputy Commissioner Mark Tatum told Reuters on Tuesday that the NBA Europe model promised a "[USN:L6N45U0IB TEXT:"much quicker path to profitability"]". Tatum added that the NBA was "prepared to proceed regardless" of whether the Euroleague collaborated on its NBA Europe project. Asked about Tatum's comments, Bertomeu, 67, warned that the path to improved economic results for shareholder clubs was no clearer under the NBA model. "If European clubs move to a model that they are told will generate much more economic activity and much higher revenues, it is not guaranteed." Bertomeu said the potential trade-off could not be measured solely in financial terms. "In exchange, they would give up control over their own future. And if, three years from now, what they have been promised does not happen, they will not be able to change anything," he said. "In 26 years (of Euroleague), I was there for 22. During those 22 years we made mistakes, but we had the ability to correct them. We decided to change course and made our own decisions. (In NBA Europe) that would no longer be the case." NBA sources told Reuters on Thursday that all shareholding clubs would participate in league governance, just as they do in the NBA. Bertomeu led Euroleague Basketball from its creation in 2000 until stepping down in 2022. He said the NBA could make its biggest contribution to the growth of Euroleague clubs in commercial operations and stadium infrastructure. "I have no doubt that the NBA could do an extraordinary commercial job. That is where the NBA could do great things. "I believe these should be the points of collaboration between the two parties," said Bertomeu, adding that format changes and economic reform were unnecessary.

item.title: 仏でシャモンダウイルスのヒト感染確認、世界初 患者は死亡
item.description:
Sybille de La Hamaide
[パリ ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Sybille de La Hamaide

[パリ ２２日 ロイター] - フランス政府は２２日、主に牛などの家畜が感染するシャモンダウイルスについて、ヒトへの感染を世界で初めて確認したと発表した。患者はその後、死亡した。ただ、現段階で一般市民へのリスクはないとしている。

国際獣疫事務局（ＷＯＡＨ）によると、シャモンダウイルスは吸血性昆虫のヌカカが媒介する。牛のほか、馬やアルパカ、羊、ヤギでも確認されている。

政府の声明によると、患者はフランス東部でウイルスを保有するヌカカに刺された疑いがある。同地域では今春から夏にかけて動物の間でウイルスが広がっていた。

国連の世界保健機関（ＷＨＯ）は、今回の感染について仏当局と連絡を取っていると明らかにしたうえで、「現時点で得られている情報と近縁のウイルスの感染経路に関する知見に基づけば、これはヒトへの単発の感染例であり、現段階で感染拡大につながる可能性は低い」と説明した。

仏政府も、一般市民への健康リスクは確認されていないとした。

地元紙ル・プログレによると、患者はリヨン地域に住む６０代の男性。ストックホルムに本部を置く欧州疾病予防管理センター（ＥＣＤＣ）によると、患者は１０月上旬に死亡した。重い病気の治療を受けており、一般の人より感染しやすい状態だった。

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg, Meta’s designated first citizen
item.description: The Facebook founder doesn’t hide his admiration for Roman Emperor Augustus. An agreement allows him to sell new non-voting stock to pay a tax bill. Doing so, gives him a larger purse to pursue bigger dreams of conquest while retaining absolute control. Caveat emptor applies.
item.dc:creator: Robert Cyran
item.content:encoded: Mark Zuckerberg has never hidden his obsession with Rome and emperor Augustus. A new agreement keeps Meta Platforms’ (META.O) first citizen in the $1.8 trillion company’s capital of Menlo Park, California for eight years. It also allows the founder, chairman and chief executive to pursue bigger dreams of conquest while retaining absolute control. Zuckerberg has some 60% of the company's vote because of Class B shares, which have 10 votes a piece. Yet his economic stake is far less at around 14%. A proposed California tax would hit billionaires like Zuckerberg for 5% of their wealth. He told Meta’s board he might move out of the Golden State, according to the New York Times. It’s understandable directors want the boss in California. Under his leadership, the Facebook and Instagram operator has grown from start up to one of the most valuable companies on earth. Zuckerberg’s focus may be on Meta’s big push into artificial intelligence, but having a leader around the office still delivers better results according to a study by researchers at Boston College and Arizona State University. The company will issue one non-voting Class C share for each existing share investors have. Zuckerberg can sell up to 20% of his immediately, and the remainder in steps, without reducing his voting power. In exchange he stays put instead of relocating out of state. It’s not obvious that Zuckerberg would actually move, let alone leave the company. His desire for retaining power reflects his care for the entity he built. The new shares will be useful for many things. Meta can use them to buy rivals, compensate workers, or raise money to invest in data centers. The company will need this ability, as its artificial intelligence push chews up resources. On Wednesday, the company said it burned over $2 billion in cash in the third quarter. Shareholders have revolted before. In 2017 the company abandoned an attempt to issue non-voting stock. What’s different today is the expensive race to dominate machine learning. Perhaps the opportunity is so big, and the increasing number of tech giants with non-voting stock like SpaceX (SPCX.O) , that equity owners will play along. Rome’s history, though, is hardly an endorsement of letting one person hold absolute power. If things start to go wrong, Meta’s ruler can essentially ignore plebeian investors. Follow Robert Cyran on Bluesky . Meta Platforms said on October 21 that the board had approved a new class of non-voting stock. All Class A and B owners would be issued one new Class C share for each share held. Founder, Chief Executive and Chair Mark Zuckerberg agreed to a deal wherein he can sell up to 20% of his Class C shares in exchange for a commitment to stay in California and remain head of the company for eight years. If he sells more of the shares, his voting stake will be reduced. The restriction on his remaining Class C shares will be lifted in steps over this period. Zuckerberg has a 60% voting stake and owns just over 13% of all shares. The company also reported third quarter results on October 21. In the three months ending September 30, the company had $2.1 billion of negative free cash flow. Meta’s stock fell 6% in early trading on the morning of October 22. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: Trump says LeBron James showed disrespect during US national anthem
item.description: US President Donald Trump criticized NBA superstar LeBron James on Thursday for what he called disrespectful behavior during the singing of the national anthem at a recent NBA game.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump criticized NBA superstar LeBron James on Thursday for what he called disrespectful behavior during the singing of the national anthem at a recent NBA game. "While listening to our National Anthem, LeBron James disrespects our Country," Trump said in a Truth Social post accompanied by a video showing James moving his body during the singing of the anthem. "LeBron James should apologize to all of those Great American Warriors and Heroes who died for the American Flag, and all that our Country stands for!" The clip Trump shared showed James standing in line with the members of the Philadelphia 76ers, swinging his arms in a warmup-type stretch and performing basketball shooting movements. A representative for the 76ers did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Trump has repeatedly criticized athletes for their behavior during pre-game renditions of the US national anthem, notably beginning with NFL quarterback Colin Kaepernick's kneeling protest in support of racial justice. Trump canceled a planned White House visit of the Super Bowl champions Philadelphia Eagles in 2018 after the team disagreed with his call for players to stand during the anthem. James became a leading voice in the Black Lives Matter movement in 2020 and has [USN:L1N34L0CT TEXT:"frequently supported"] progressive issues as he ascended to the top of the NBA's all-time scoring list.

item.title: Trump ordered to sit for deposition in his $10 billion BBC lawsuit
item.description: A federal judge on Thursday ordered Donald Trump to sit for a deposition by December 11 in his $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC, which has accused the US president of stalling to avoid answering questions under oath.
item.dc:creator: Jack Queen
item.content:encoded: A federal judge on Thursday ordered Donald Trump to sit for a deposition by December 11 in his $10 billion [USN:L1N3WQ18J TEXT:"defamation lawsuit"] against the BBC, which has accused the US president of stalling to avoid answering questions under oath. Trump is suing Britain’s publicly funded broadcaster for at least $10 billion over a [USN:S8N3TC0DO TEXT:"misleadingly edited"] clip of a speech. The case is one of several Trump has privately filed against the news media as part of a wider [USN:L6N40Z025 TEXT:"pressure campaign"] against [USN:L8N45A1OV TEXT:"coverage he dislikes"]. US Magistrate Judge Enjolique Lett ordered Trump to take questions from the BBC’s lawyers under oath in a ruling from the bench at a court hearing on Thursday, according to a spokesman for Trump's personal legal team. Trump canceled a deposition in October, citing conflicts with his presidential duties. The Trump spokesman said the lawsuit is aimed at holding the BBC accountable for defamation and “reckless election interference.” The BBC declined to comment. It previously admitted the edits were misleading and apologized to Trump, though it denies being liable for defamation. Trump’s lawsuit filed in December in Florida federal court accuses the BBC of intentionally misleading viewers into thinking he directed supporters to storm the US Capitol by splicing together different parts of a January 6, 2021, speech. In court filings, the broadcaster has accused Trump and his lawyers of dragging their feet in response to their requests for records and other information that is exchanged between parties in a process known as discovery. The BBC is seeking financial records from Trump's Mar-a-Lago club and the web of business entities associated with him, saying the information is necessary to defend against Trump’s damages claims. Trump’s lawyers say the requests are too broad and irrelevant to the case. They have also denied in court filings that Trump is avoiding a deposition, saying Trump's duties and security needs must take precedence. The edited speech appeared in a BBC "Panorama" documentary show shortly before the 2024 presidential election, which Trump won. A leaked internal BBC memo cited the edits as evidence of potential political bias, sparking a public relations crisis for the broadcaster and leading to high-level resignations.

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２２日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２２日、イランが米国の中間選挙を前に原油価格を押し上げようとしているとの認識を示した。

トランプ氏は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に「イランは中間選挙を前に原油価格をつり上げるため、できる限りのことをしている」と投稿。「現在は戦闘開始前より多くの原油がホルムズ海峡を通過しているため、イランは偽の攻撃や機雷など、あらゆるものをでっち上げている」と主張した。

このほか、イランは「抗議活動参加者や邪魔になる者を殺し続けている」と主張。「本当に邪悪な政権だ」とし、「世界や民主党（トランプ氏は『Dumocrat Party』と表記）が気にかけていないように見えるのは衝撃的だ」とした。

また「イランは決して核兵器を保有できない。決して保有することはない！」と記した。

BUCHAREST, Oct 22 (Reuters) – Romanian President Nicusor Dan called on the government on Thursday to ensure children’s safety in the classroom and online after two violent attacks in schools in less than a week.

Police said a 15-year-old had attacked two classmates with a machete on Thursday in a bathroom of their high school in the central Romanian city of Pitesti.

On Monday, a 13-year-old schoolboy stabbed and wounded a teacher and another pupil. Local media reported that he had posted about his plans on social media shortly before the attack.

Show Full Article

“Two signals that we can no longer afford to ignore,” Dan said in a post on X.

“We need safer schools, supported and prepared teachers to intervene, real access to psychological counseling, but also measures for the protection of minors in using the online space,” the centrist president added.

Romania’s newly installed government will hold a meeting on Friday to discuss school safety measures.

Schools in Europe have faced a string of attacks this year in countries including Poland, France and Sweden, with authorities in some cases pointing to the role of social media and online subcultures that glorify murder in fomenting the violence.

(Reporting by Luiza Ilie; Editing by Toby Chopra)

item.title: L'Oreal Q3 sales beat forecasts as consumers indulge in premium beauty
item.description: French cosmetics group L'Oreal beat third-quarter sales forecasts on Thursday, as shoppers around the world indulge in more pricy haircare and premium skin products.
item.dc:creator: Dominique Patton
item.content:encoded: French cosmetics group L'Oreal (OREP.PA) beat third-quarter sales forecasts on Thursday, as shoppers around the world indulge in more pricy haircare and premium skin products. The Paris-based maker of CeraVe moisturiser and Prada perfumes has doubled down on its premium offer in recent years, adding more couture perfumes to its stable of blockbuster names and rolling out new haircare products under its professional hair salon brand Kerastase. Its weight in both segments is allowing it to profit from growing global spending on beauty, including in China where demand for higher-end brands is accelerating. Sales from July to September rose 7.7% on an adjusted like-for-like basis to €11.56 billion ($12.95 billion), topping analysts' consensus forecast for 5.9% growth in a Visible Alpha poll. The number strips out currency effects and the effects from phasing in of a new global IT system. "The global beauty market, once again, proved its resilience in a challenging context — and we continued to significantly outpace it," CEO Nicolas Hieronimus said in a statement. L'Oreal's US-listed shares rose 8.3% after the sales report. Beauty has been a bright spot in an otherwise sluggish consumer goods sector, with analysts and executives pointing to the "lipstick effect" of consumers treating themselves to affordable luxuries during challenging times. L'Oreal's luxury division, which generates more than a third of group revenue, grew 7% on a like-for-like basis, well ahead of a 4.5% forecast, helped by strong demand for its best-selling fragrances like Prada Paradigme and for high-end skincare in China. China's beauty market is expanding again after two years of contraction, as middle-class consumers shift spending from entry-level luxury goods towards [USN:L6N44008X TEXT:"prestige beauty"] products. Growth slowed slightly in the third quarter against a tougher base of comparison than earlier in the year, Hieronimus told analysts on a call, but some brands like Helena Rubinstein are growing in 'high double-digits'. "Our products are more affordable than higher-priced luxury and consumers are indulging in them," he said. Other skincare lines like SkinCeuticals and La Roche-Posay which has launched new sunscreen and serums are also growing in double-digits, he added, while the company is also targeting consumers using [USN:L4N45K10K TEXT:"GLP-1 weight-loss drugs"], promoting products aimed at addressing secondary effects such as sagging facial skin. Sales in Europe, L'Oreal's biggest market, rose nearly 9%, while revenue in South Asia and the Middle East jumped 19.5% on strong demand in Gulf countries and Vietnam. Shares in L'Oreal, France's most valuable listed company, are up 11% this year. ($1 = 0.8927 euros)

item.title: Rhode Island sues Meta over alleged tolerance for scam advertising
item.description: Rhode Island sued Meta Platforms in state court on Thursday over the company's alleged tolerance for widespread scam advertising on its Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp platforms.
item.dc:creator: Jeff Horwitz, Katie Paul
item.content:encoded: Rhode Island sued Meta Platforms (META.O) in state court on Thursday over the company's alleged tolerance for widespread scam advertising on its Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp platforms. The suit, filed by Rhode Island Attorney General Peter Neronha in Providence Superior Court, accuses Meta of unlawfully profiting from and participating in the creation of billions of dollars in scam advertising – even as it assured its billions of users that it was working diligently to protect them. It is the first such scams-related case to be brought against Meta by a US state, following a [USN:L1N41O010 TEXT:"similar lawsuit"] filed in May by California's Santa Clara County. The complaint seeks monetary civil penalties for each of Meta's alleged violations of Rhode Island state law, restitution to consumers, disgorgement of ill-gotten gains and a judicial order requiring the company to address, rather than profit from, scam ads it develops and delivers on its platforms. "As alleged, Meta knowingly exposed vulnerable users to fraud and scams, and made enormous profits in doing so. When companies, big or small, take advantage of Rhode Island consumers, this office will do everything within our authority to hold them to account," Neronha said in a press release. Meta said it would fight the lawsuit, calling it "unfounded," and noting that the company regularly partners with law enforcement to disrupt scam networks. "The attorney general refused to engage with us on ways we protect Rhode Islanders from scams, and has instead hired an out-of-state private law firm to concoct a lawsuit that ignores the full range of actions we take to combat scams every day," Meta spokesperson Andy Stone said in a statement. Stone noted that Meta has removed more than 159 million scam ads and launched new anti-fraud tools in the past year alone, like alerts flagging suspicious friend requests on Facebook, expanded advertiser verification and warnings about risky device-linking requests on WhatsApp. HIGH-RISK SCAM ADS The suit was filed a day after a judge in New Mexico ordered Meta to pay that state $25 billion in a case in which [USN:L6N45F10O TEXT:"a jury found"] the company had misled consumers about the privacy of their data. Meta also agreed in August to [USN:L6N44N0VA TEXT:"pay up to $18 billion"] in a settlement with nearly all US states to resolve claims it designed its platforms to addict children. Rhode Island's complaint cites Reuters reporting from last year on internal Meta documents outlining the vast scale of fraudulent advertising on the company's platforms – and Meta's calculations that it was earning far more from high-risk scam ads than it expected to pay in fines for allowing them. According to those documents, Meta displays around 15 billion "higher risk" scam ads to users every day, and earned roughly 10% of its 2024 revenue from fraudulent e-commerce, dubious health products and other banned marketing. In many cases, Rhode Island's suit alleged, Meta's AI ad creation tools actively assisted scammers with their fraudulent marketing. Rather than consistently blocking advertisers that its automated detection systems suspected of fraud, Rhode Island alleged, Meta sometimes charged them extra as a penalty. "Meta knowingly helped create and optimize these ads to ensure that they were as effective as possible and then lied about them, misrepresenting to the public its commitment to prevent fraud on its platforms," the suit stated. The company has disputed the Reuters reporting. "We aggressively fight fraud and scams because people on our platforms don't want this content, legitimate advertisers don't want it and we don't want it either," Stone said in response to the reporting last year, calling it "a selective view that distorts Meta's approach to fraud and scams." In the months since Reuters published the stories, Meta has claimed progress on anti-scam initiatives. At a White House [USN:L6N46618F TEXT:"event on cybercrime prevention"] on Wednesday, US Attorney General Todd Blanche called the company an "incredible partner to law enforcement." But Rhode Island alleged that scams remain rampant and readily findable in the company's ad library, a database of ads run on Meta's platforms. "The ad below, for example, promised to reverse Alzheimer's in 45 days," Rhode Island's complaint stated of one set of scam ads. "There were more than 2,000 versions of this ad active in the Meta Ad library." TARGETING THE ELDERLY Often the fraudulent ads targeted elderly people, Rhode Island alleged, citing an investigation by the nonprofit Center for Countering Digital Hate, which identified nearly 94,000 scam ads on Meta's platforms. "Some of these advertisers spent more on Meta ads over a several year period than large brands like Walmart or Pfizer," the lawsuit stated. Beyond scams, the Rhode Island attorney general's office said it found that Meta was similarly failing to police other types of illicit ads, such as for AI apps for deepfake pornography. In one example provided by the state, an ad featured side-by-side images of a fully clothed woman in a coffee shop next to an image of her engaged in a sex act. Rhode Island also cited examples of scam ads impersonating public figures and trusted institutions like banks to leverage their credibility, including a case in which scammers in China used the name and image of a senior Bank of America executive in ads on Facebook and Instagram that lured users into scam stock trades on WhatsApp. Public survey data cited by Rhode Island – and Meta's own internal appraisals obtained by Reuters – indicate that the company's platforms are responsible for a disproportionate share of online scams and that Meta's scam defenses were weaker than those of its main digital advertising competitors. "It is easier to advertise scams on Meta platforms than Google," concluded an internal Meta review in April 2025. Meta nonetheless sought to defeat regulatory efforts to require verification, Rhode Island said. The lawsuit stated that "a banned advertiser can reappear in the time it takes to provide a new email address or phone number."

item.title: 米マイクロン、27年から全世界で業績連動報酬導入へ 台湾労組の圧力受け
item.description:
Wen-Yee Lee
[台北 ２２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーは２２日、２０２７会計年度...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米マイクロン、27年から全世界で業績連動報酬導入へ　台湾労組の圧力受け 1:14 配信

米マイクロンの施設。台湾・台中市で１５日撮影。REUTERS/Ann Wang

Wen-Yee Lee

[台北 ２２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーは２２日、２０２７会計年度から全世界の従業員を対象に、四半期ごとの業績連動型報酬制度を導入すると発表した。人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームで得られた利益のうち、従業員への分配をより多くするよう求める台湾の労働組合の圧力を受けた措置となる。

マイクロンは、新たな制度は既存の年次インセンティブ制度を補完するものだと説明。韓国の競合サムスン電子やＳＫハイニックスの制度と異なり、マイクロンは利益の配分比率や従業員向けに確保された総額については開示していない。

マイクロンによると、四半期ごとの賞与原資は、２６会計年度を基準年として、税引き後利益から次四半期の予想設備投資額を差し引いた額を基に算出する。賞与の半分は決算発表後に現金で支給され、残りは１年後に権利が確定する株式で支払われる。

ただ、新しい生産能力が収益を生み出し始める前に工場や設備に多額の投資を行うため、この方式では基礎的な業績が改善しても、生産能力拡大の局面では支給額が制限される可能性がある。

今回の発表は、２１日にマイクロンの大規模な台中事業所の労組との間で成立した合意を受けたものとなる。桃園の別の労組との協議は、２２日時点で合意に至っていない。

item.title: Rendimiento bonos Tesoro EEUU se hunde ya que resurgen temores sobre sostenibilidad del auge de la IA
item.description: El rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos se hundió el jueves, ante una liquidación del mercado bursátil por renovadas preocupaciones sobre la sostenibilidad de las perspectivas de la inteligencia artificial, lo que potenció el atractivo de la deuda pública como valor de refugio.
item.dc:creator: Chuck Mikolajczak
item.content:encoded: El rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos se hundió el jueves, ante una liquidación del mercado bursátil por renovadas preocupaciones sobre la sostenibilidad de las perspectivas de la inteligencia artificial, lo que potenció el atractivo de la deuda pública como valor de refugio. * El Nasdaq se desplomaba más de un 2%, mientras que las acciones de Meta (META.O) perdían casi un 8% tras la publicación de los resultados trimestrales de la empresa y el anuncio de nuevos valores sin derecho a voto destinados a financiar la expansión de la empresa de redes sociales en el ámbito de la IA. * Los retornos han bajado en los últimos días, ya que las preocupaciones sobre una desaceleración del gasto en IA y su impacto en el crecimiento económico han eclipsado los datos económicos, que mostraban presiones inflacionarias persistentes. * Los inversores ya habían descontado la inflación y la perspectiva de alzas de las tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal, pero los cambios en los activos de riesgo y en las condiciones financieras están impulsando ahora la demanda de bonos, según Thomas Urano, de Sage Advisory en Austin, Texas. * "La batalla entre las preocupaciones por la energía y la inflación y la demanda de refugio en los bonos del Tesoro lleva tiempo en marcha, pero en la última semana vemos quién está ganando ahora. La tendencia de 'huida hacia la calidad' está ganando terreno en el mercado de los bonos del Tesoro", señaló. * El rendimiento de la deuda referencial a 10 años cayó 19,3 puntos básicos (pb), al 4,953%, en su mayor descenso diario desde el 10 de marzo de 2023. Tocó el 7 de octubre su nivel más alto desde abril de 2002, al 5,3645%. * El retorno de las notas a 30 años restó 15 pb, al 5,287%, su retroceso diario más pronunciado desde agosto de 2024, mientras que el de los papeles a dos años , que suele moverse en línea con las expectativas de tasas de la Fed, se hundió 18,5 pb, al 4,638%, su mayor descenso en un día desde agosto de 2025. * Pese a los recientes datos que apuntan a un alza de la presión sobre los precios, los mercados descartan una subida de tasas de la Fed la próxima semana. La probabilidad de un aumento de al menos 25 pb se ha hundido al 7,2%, según la herramienta FedWatch de CME, frente al 27,7% de hace una semana y el 55,4% de un mes atrás.

item.title: FIFA opens bidding for 2030 and 2034 World Cup media rights covering US and Puerto Rico
item.description: FIFA launched an invitation to tender on Thursday for media rights in the United States and Puerto Rico for the 2030 World Cup along with an option to secure the 2034 edition.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: FIFA launched an invitation to tender on Thursday for media rights in the United States and Puerto Rico for the 2030 World Cup along with an option to secure the 2034 edition. FIFA said in a press release that it is open to "innovative approaches" to reach large audiences and that the bid submission deadline is November 19. Fox held the exclusive English-language broadcast rights in the United States for the 2026 World Cup co-hosted by the US, Canada and Mexico while Telemundo held the Spanish language rights. Spain, which won the 2026 World Cup, will co-host the 2030 edition with Portugal and Morocco, although Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay will stage inaugural matches marking the tournament's 100th anniversary. Saudi Arabia have been named hosts of the 2034 World Cup. According to FIFA, the 2026 World Cup averaged 13.5 million viewers per match on linear and streaming platforms in the United States, up 166% on the 2022 World Cup in Qatar. Earlier this week, [USN:L6N45Z0QE TEXT:"Netflix"] announced that it secured the rights to broadcast the 2030 World Cup in Spain and Andorra.

item.title: Kering-Le recul des ventes de Gucci au T3 pèse sur les espoirs de relance
item.description: Le groupe de luxe français Kering a annoncé jeudi une baisse des ventes de Gucci au troisième trimestre, la faiblesse persistante de la fréquentation de ses magasins compliquant les efforts de redressement engagés par son directeur général Luca de Meo.
item.dc:creator: Tassilo Hummel, Alessandro Parodi, Elena Smirnova
item.content:encoded: Le groupe de luxe français Kering (PRTP.PA) a annoncé jeudi une baisse des ventes de Gucci au troisième trimestre, la faiblesse persistante de la fréquentation de ses magasins compliquant les efforts de redressement engagés par son directeur général Luca de Meo. [USN:L8N40Z0D8 TEXT:"Luca de Meo"], vétéran de l'industrie automobile qui a pris les rênes du groupe l'an dernier, tente de redresser Kering à travers un plan stratégique sur cinq ans visant à doubler sa marge opérationnelle. Mais les tensions au Moyen-Orient, la faiblesse de la demande en Chine et le ralentissement de la dynamique de consommation aux États-Unis compliquent la réalisation de cet objectif. Les ventes trimestrielles inférieures aux attentes publiées récemment par [USN:L8N45Y1DP TEXT:"LVMH"] et [USN:L8N4680BW TEXT:"Hermès"], ainsi que les signes d'un ralentissement de la demande aux États-Unis, ont renforcé les inquiétudes des investisseurs quant au redressement de Kering. Interrogée lors d'une conférence téléphonique sur la possibilité d'un retour à la croissance du groupe cette année, la directrice financière Armelle Poulou n'a pas souhaité commenter les perspectives, renvoyant à la publication des résultats annuels. Les certificats américains de dépôt (ADR) de Kering ont chuté de 11% après la publication de l'activité trimestrielle du groupe. Les ventes de Gucci, qui représentent environ la moitié du résultat opérationnel du groupe, se sont établies à 1,29 milliard d'euros au cours du trimestre. Sur l'ensemble du groupe, le chiffre d'affaires a reculé de 1% à données comparables. Selon Kering, la principale difficulté de Gucci reste la baisse de la fréquentation des magasins, particulièrement en Chine. Les ventes de la marque ont également légèrement reculé en Amérique du Nord. Pour attirer davantage de clients dans les magasins Gucci, Kering prévoit d'accroître ses investissements dans le marketing et l'expérience client, a déclaré Armelle Poulou. "Nous poursuivons l'exécution de notre plan avec la plus grande discipline", a déclaré Armelle Poulou. Elle a ajouté que le groupe avait déjà réduit son réseau de distribution de 105 magasins et anticipait désormais au moins 125 fermetures nettes sur l’exercice 2026. PRESSION SUR DEMNA Kering a nommé l'an dernier Luca de Meo pour restructurer le groupe. Après une hausse initiale à l'annonce de son arrivée, le titre Kering a perdu de son élan. L'action affiche un recul d'environ 8% sur un an, dans un contexte de repli plus général du secteur du luxe. Luca de Meo vise à doubler la marge opérationnelle de Kering d'ici à la fin de la décennie, à partir d'un niveau de 11,1% en 2025, grâce à des réductions de coûts, à de nouvelles fermetures de magasins et à une rationalisation de la chaîne d'approvisionnement. Des analystes estiment toutefois que ces seules mesures d'efficacité ne suffiront pas à relancer des marques qui ont perdu de leur attrait. Le directeur artistique de Saint Laurent, [USN:L8N45V0BG TEXT:"Anthony Vaccarello"], et [USN:FWN4611AW TEXT:"Sean McGirr"], d'Alexander McQueen, ont tous deux quitté leurs fonctions ce mois-ci. Les médias spécialisés spéculent également sur l'avenir de Pierpaolo Piccioli, directeur artistique de Balenciaga. Ces changements devraient accentuer encore la pression sur Demna, qui s'apprête à boucler sa première année complète à la tête de Gucci, qu'il a cherché à relancer en misant sur une esthétique audacieuse et sensuelle rappelant les succès de la marque sous Tom Ford. Demna a également adopté une approche inhabituelle en matière de production, en délocalisant en Chine la fabrication de ses premiers modèles de baskets.

item.title: Arizona university suspends fraternity after rape allegation
item.description: The University of Arizona has suspended a fraternity after a female student alleged she was raped at its house by two men, the latest action taken by a major US university against a Greek chapter over accusations of sexual assault.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Hay
item.content:encoded: The University of Arizona has suspended a fraternity after a female student alleged she was raped at its house by two men, the latest action taken by a major US university against a Greek chapter over accusations of sexual assault. The university suspended Sigma Phi Epsilon, which was already on probation for hazing new members, on Wednesday after the KOLD-TV station reported the allegations of a female student who said she was raped at the chapter's fraternity house in Tucson. The university said it was investigating. "It has been determined that your organization presents a substantial risk to members of the university community," Whitney Mohr, associate dean of students, said in a letter to the fraternity. The female student told police she was at the Sigma Phi Epsilon fraternity house with friends and residents of the chapter around midnight on August 26 when she woke up in a dark room being sexually assaulted by two men, according to the September police report published by KOLD-TV. Sigma Phi Epsilon's national CEO Brian Warren said it took courage for the student to come forward, that she deserves a complete investigation, and that the fraternity does not tolerate sexual assault or sexual misconduct. "The fraternity has suspended the membership of those involved while the investigation proceeds," Warren said in a statement. "Any member found responsible will be expelled, and we will cooperate fully with law enforcement as it seeks accountability under the law." US universities have come under growing pressure to crack down on misconduct following allegations of sexual assault by fraternity members at [USN:L6N45Z16I TEXT:"Cornell University"]. Earlier this month, the University of Arizona suspended all fraternity activities during investigations into alleged hazing, physical assault and drug and alcohol violations.

item.title: トルコ中銀、利下げ再開 政策金利36％
item.description: ［イスタンブール ２２日 ロイター］ - トルコ中央銀行は２２日の金融政策決定会合で、主要政策金利を１００ベーシスポイ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
トルコ中銀、利下げ再開　政策金利36％ 1:05 配信

２０２４年２月撮影　REUTERS/Cagla Gurdogan

［イスタンブール　２２日　ロイター］ - トルコ中央銀行は２２日の金融政策決定会合で、主要政策金利を１００ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き下げ、３６．０％にすると決定した。市場予想とほぼ一致した。２月末に始まった米イラン交戦がインフレに与える影響を見極めるため５会合連続で金利を据え置いていた。エネルギー価格は大幅に上昇しているものの、輸入依存型のトルコ経済への影響が懸念されたほどではないとの見方から利下げに踏み切ったもようだ。

ロイターがまとめた調査で、２２人のエコノミストが利下げを予想。据え置き予想は２人だった。今年１２月の会合でさらに１００ｂｐの利下げが見込まれている。金融緩和局面は２０２７年に入っても続き、政策金利は２７年３月末に３３％、６月末に３１％、９月末に３０％、１２月末には２８％まで低下していくと見られている。

トルコの２６年９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は前月比１．８４％上昇と市場予想を下回った。前年同月比では２９．７３％上昇した。ロイター調査で、２６年末時点のインフレ率予想は２９．５％。２７年末には２３．７％まで鈍化すると見込まれている。２６年の経済成長率は２．７％、２７年は３．７％に加速すると予想されている。政府は２６年の成長率見通しを３．３％、２７年は４．２％としている。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：日米金融政策の転換とドル／円の行方＝植野大作氏 コラム：サービス価格上昇に加速の気配、日銀の緩和修正判断に影響も コラム：漸進的な日銀の緩和修正、ドル130円割れは短期間か＝植野大作氏 コラム：ドル／円の昨年高値更新に現実味、中立金利や介入効果に注目＝内田稔氏 コラム：食品値下げは広がるのか、日銀判断にも影響する分岐点に 最終更新: 10/23(金) 1:05 ロイター

item.title: External evaluators find flaws in OpenAI's AI monitoring system in pilot review
item.description: AI safety evaluators METR and Redwood Research found several new vulnerabilities in OpenAI's internal system, including an exploit agents could have used to keep hundreds of their actions from being monitored, in a pilot review earlier this year.
item.dc:creator: Aditya Soni
item.content:encoded: AI safety evaluators METR and Redwood Research found several new vulnerabilities in OpenAI's internal system, including an exploit agents could have used to keep hundreds of their actions from being monitored, in a pilot review earlier this year. The exercise, conducted from July 21 to August 11, gave outside researchers "a deep level of access" to OpenAI's internal infrastructure for so-called embedded evaluations, the safety nonprofits said on Thursday. METR and Redwood said they each sent one researcher, tested an arrangement giving access to OpenAI's internal code, documentation and some technical staff. Both were accompanied on site and used OpenAI-issued devices that "never left the premises". OpenAI told the safety organizations it has since patched all vulnerabilities affecting its production safeguards, although METR and Redwood said they had not verified the fixes. AI labs, experts and the Trump administration have touted independent evaluation by outside reviewers as a way to safely advance the technology without slowing its development. However, AI companies are worried that evaluator staff working inside the companies' walls could take proprietary information to rivals, Reuters [USN:L1N45S0TG TEXT:"reported"] earlier this month. While OpenAI received a full 61-page internal report, METR and Redwood said they agreed to publish only a broad summary publicly, and gave OpenAI the right to redact sensitive information. Unlike in some previous evaluations, they could not independently disclose those redactions, but said they expected greater transparency in future evaluations. The researchers also identified a potential way for OpenAI's Codex agents to bypass security restrictions and act with their users' full permissions. The evaluators assessed the monitoring system as it existed on and before July 21, and noted that OpenAI was expanding the system during the exercise. OpenAI said the "findings helped strengthen safeguards as we expanded the system and will help shape future research collaborations with METR and other third-party evaluators."

item.title: Yes Bank unlikely to pay AT1 bond coupons despite bond holders demand, sources say
item.description: Yes Bank has announced potential non-payment of coupons on additional tier-1 bonds this fiscal year following a Supreme Court decision that annulled the previous write-off of these bonds. Bondholders are advocating for repayment based on the court's ruling, which emphasizes unsettled dues. Nonetheless, Yes Bank maintains it has ultimate authority over coupon payments, raising concerns about its financial losses impacting these obligations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's Yes Bank is unlikely to pay coupons due this year on its additional tier-1 (AT1) bonds despite a Supreme Court ruling overturning their write-off during the lender's 2020 rescue, two persons familiar with the matter said.The bank is preparing to seek a review of the ruling, one of the sources told Reuters, while bondholders press for payment of coupons that have remained unpaid since Yes Bank wrote the bonds off six years ago.Last week, India's Supreme Court upheld a 2023 Bombay High Court ruling that set aside Yes Bank's write-off of 84 billion rupees ($886 million) worth of AT1 bonds, in a setback to the lender and regulators that had defended the move.Yes Bank did not respond to an email seeking comment.The sources declined to be named as they were not authorised to speak on the matter.Retail investors holding the bonds said on Thursday they had not received coupon payments due on October 18, three days after the SC ruling.In a letter to Axis Trustee Services Ltd, reviewed by Reuters, investors sought clarity on the status of coupon payments and urged the debenture trustee to intervene. We call upon the Trustee to obtain immediate written confirmation from Yes Bank as to whether this coupon has been paid, cancelled or remains outstanding, bondholders said.They cited the Supreme Court order that payment of annual coupons shall remain unaffected by the outcome of these appeals and must be made in terms of the Information Memoranda. The sources, however, said the bond documentation gives the bank discretion over coupon payments and that the issue can only be considered once the AT1 bonds are reinstated on the bank's balance sheet.The losses the bank accumulated during fiscal years 2020 and 2021 are expected to be fully offset only by fiscal 2028, a third source familiar with the matter told Reuters. This could weigh on the bank's decision to pay coupons on its AT1 bonds, the source added.Yes Bank carries a debit balance of 52.79 billion rupees ($557 million) in its profit and loss account, according to the lender's latest annual report.

item.title: US to host inaugural Women's Club World Cup in 2028
item.description: The United States will host the inaugural edition of the Women's Club World Cup in January 2028, FIFA said on Thursday, with seven clubs confirmed so far for the 19-team tournament.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The United States will host the inaugural edition of the Women's Club World Cup in January 2028, FIFA said on Thursday, with seven clubs confirmed so far for the 19-team tournament. Arsenal Women, Club America Femenil, FC Barcelona Femeni, Gotham FC, Naegohyang Women’s FC, SC Corinthians and Wuhan Jiangda WFC have already qualified, with a dozen more yet to be determined. The tournament will feature teams from all six confederations -- three clubs apiece from AFC, CAF, CONCACAF and CONMEBOL, one from OFC and six from UEFA. It will run from January 5 to 30. "We undertook a detailed assessment to identify the most suitable host for the inaugural edition of the FIFA Women’s Club World Cup," FIFA Chief Women’s Football Officer Sarai Bareman said in a statement. "Ultimately, the United States’ recent excellence in staging top FIFA tournaments, combined with the significant interest in women’s football there plus its elite sporting infrastructure, made the country the standout option." FIFA has been eager to tap into the lucrative [USN:L6N43I00P TEXT:"American market"], and the US staged the men's Club World Cup in 2025 and co-hosted the FIFA World Cup earlier this year with Mexico and Canada. The United States is expected to co-host the 2031 Women's World Cup with Costa Rica, Jamaica and Mexico, with formal FIFA approval due next month.

item.title: 中国チベットでＭ7の地震、人的・物的被害は不明
item.description: [２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２２日 ロイター] - 中国地震ネットワークセンター（ＣＥＮＣ）によると、中国南西部のチベット自治区で２２日午後１０時３３分（１４３３ＧＭＴ、日本時間午後１１時３３分）ごろ、マグニチュード（Ｍ）７の地震が発生した。

人的被害や建物などの被害の有無は現時点では分かっていない。

ＣＥＮＣのデータによると、震央はチベット北部ナクチュの標高の高い地域に位置し、震源の深さは１０キロ。震央から半径５キロ以内の平均標高は約４８６４メートル。

ＣＥＮＣによると、中国で発生した地震としては２０２４年１月以来の規模。震央は自治区の中心都市ラサから約４００キロ離れている。

今回の震央から約２８０キロ離れた隣接する青海省玉樹では、２０１０年にＭ７．１の地震が発生し、少なくとも２６９８人が死亡、約３００人が行方不明となった。

item.title: Gucci sales slip again in latest blow to Kering recovery plan
item.description: Gucci sales fell in the third quarter as shoppers stayed away from its stores, its owner Kering said on Thursday, blowing hopes of a rapid return to growth for Luca de Meo, who took over as CEO last year.
item.dc:creator: Tassilo Hummel, Alessandro Parodi
item.content:encoded: Gucci sales fell in the third quarter as shoppers stayed away from its stores, its owner Kering (PRTP.PA) said on Thursday, blowing hopes of a rapid return to growth for Luca de Meo, who took over as CEO last year. The former automotive industry veteran is trying to turn Kering around with a five-year plan to double its profit margin, but the Iran war, weak demand in China and slowing momentum in the [USN:L8N45R16S TEXT:"United States"] are frustrating that ambition. Lower-than-expected quarterly sales at [USN:L6N45Y0VL TEXT:"LVMH"] (LVMH.PA) and [USN:L6N4680E3 TEXT:"Hermes"] (HRMS.PA) have added to investor concerns over Kering and asked on media call if returning to overall growth was still the aim this year, its finance chief Armelle Poulou declined to comment, pointing to the publication of full-year results. Kering's American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) were down 11% following its trading update, which showed sales at Gucci, which accounts for roughly half of group profit, were down 6% when adjusted for currency moves to €1.29 billion ($1.44 billion) in the quarter, while group revenue fell 1%. Footfall, in particular in China, is the main problem at Gucci, where sales have been falling for more than three years, Kering said. Gucci sales also slid slightly in North America. Kering plans to ramp up spending on marketing and client experience to attract more shoppers, Poulou said. "We keep on carrying out our plan with the utmost discipline," Poulou said, adding Kering has so far reduced its retail network by 105 stores and was targeting 125 closures by the end of the year. PRESSURE ON DESIGNER DEMNA Kering last year tapped De Meo to overhaul the group. Its shares had an early price bounce under the former Renault chief before cooling off, with the stock down 8% from a year earlier amid a wider sector downturn. [USN:S8N3SZ01C TEXT:"De Meo"] aims to double Kering's profit margin from 11.1% in 2025 by the end of the decade through cost cuts, more store closures and a push to streamline supply chains. But analysts have said mere efficiency measures will not be enough to turn around a business whose brands have lost appeal. Both [USN:L6N45V0BJ TEXT:"Anthony Vaccarello"], the creative director of its second-biggest brand Saint Laurent, and Alexander McQueen designer [USN:L6N46114V TEXT:"Sean McGirr"] left their posts this month. Fashion industry media have also speculated about the future of Balenciaga's creative director Pierpaolo Piccioli. The recent changes are likely to pile even more pressure on Demna, who is nearing his first full year at the helm of Gucci, which he sought to reignite with a bold bet on daring, sexy styles reminiscent of the brand's successes under Tom Ford. Demna also took some [USN:L6N45D0BT TEXT:"unusual manufacturing steps"], moving the production of his first sneaker models to China. ($1 = 0.8934 euros)

AUSTIN, Texas, Oct 22 : British teenager Freddie Slater will make his Formula One practice debut with Audi in Mexico next week, the team said on Thursday. • The 18-year-old, first recruit to Audi's F1 driver development programme and one of Britain's emerging talents in junior series, will also take part in first Friday practice in Brazil the week after. • Slater was Formula Three runner-up in his rookie season this year and is moving up to Formula Two, the last rung before Formula One, next year. • "It is the right time for Freddie to step up," said Audi racing director Allan McNish. "These appearances in Mexico and Brazil will give him valuable experience of a Formula One race weekend and another chance to continue his development before he steps up to Formula Two". • Slater missed out on the F3 title to McLaren junior driver Ugo Ugochukwu last month after going into the final round in Spain 15 points clear of his U.S. rival.

item.title: Ahead of the US midterms, Gen Z investors are making portfolio changes
item.description: Brandon Gaw is monitoring the news to adjust investments that he thinks could be hit hard by pre-election volatility ahead of the US midterms.
item.dc:creator: Hani Richter
item.content:encoded: Brandon Gaw, an Oregon-based engineering student and investor. Courtesy Brandon Gaw/Handout via REUTERS Brandon Gaw, an Oregon-based engineering student and investor, isn't just watching the news to stay in the know. He's also monitoring it to adjust investments that he thinks could be hit hard by pre-election volatility ahead of the US midterms . “When others are fearful, that's the best time to invest,” he says. One issue the 22-year-old is watching closely is the prospect of tighter restrictions involving Chinese-made memory chips entering the US market, as well as increased competition. Against this backdrop, Gaw says he is holding more cash and selling shares in smaller and newer companies that are more dependent on investors' excitement about AI, which he believes could be especially vulnerable to election uncertainty. Every few weeks, Gaw trades stocks worth $5,000 to $10,000. “In my opinion, those are going to get hit the most,” he says. Brandon Gaw, an Oregon-based engineering student and investor. Courtesy Brandon Gaw/Handout via REUTERS Gaw accepts he’s taking more risk because of his age compared to an investor who may need their money sooner for retirement or a house. But he’s also investing in more established companies, including Microsoft, Google, Nvidia and Apple. “If anything, I added a few more positions in those companies,” he says. “I don't think they're going to run out of business anytime soon.” For now, Gaw’s portfolio is fairly spread out: crypto, gold and silver collectively account for about 5% to 10%; ETFs make up around 30%; and individual stocks account for 60%. He has not made changes to his retirement investments. Taking a long-term view, Gaw says a market dip does not matter much to him if the S&P 500 falls. “I think these pullbacks are pretty good buying opportunities,” he says. THE WIDER TREND Nearly three-quarters of Gen Z investors have changed their retirement savings or portfolios in anticipation of the midterm election outcomes, compared to just 17% of Baby Boomers, according to a recent Nationwide Retirement Institute survey of over 2,000 US investors. Tyler McConville, a Wisconsin-based certified financial planner and private wealth advisor at Capital Group, says “The challenge is determining which information actually matters to a long-term financial plan.” While it is important to pay attention to elections and policy changes, markets have historically been influenced more by economic fundamentals and specific policy outcomes. “The biggest risk is when investors make long-term portfolio decisions based on short-term political concerns,” he says. KEY TAKEAWAYS Don’t make speculative trades. Use market-moving events as a reminder to review your investments and to consider how elections could affect certain sectors. Keep diversification in mind. Gaw spreads his investments across individual stocks, ETFs, crypto and precious metals, while reducing his exposure to stocks that he considers volatile. A diversified portfolio can help limit reliance on any one investment or sector. Focus on economic fundamentals. Rather than assuming one political party will be good or bad for stocks, consider factors such as inflation, interest rates, corporate earnings and specific policy changes when assessing your investments. Have a money lesson or story to share? Tell us what worked for you — or what didn’t — by emailing hani.richter@tr.com .

item.title: メタ株6.5％安、ＡＩ投資負担を懸念 ＣＤＳも過去最高水準
item.description: [２２日 ロイター] - ２２日午前の米株式市場で、メタ・プラットフォームズの株価が６．５％下落し、一時約６週間ぶり...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
メタ株6.5％安、ＡＩ投資負担を懸念　ＣＤＳも過去最高水準 0:36 配信

2025年6月12日、フランス・パリで撮影。 REUTERS/Benoit Tessier/File Photo

[２２日 ロイター] - ２２日午前の米株式市場で、メタ・プラットフォームズの株価が６．５％下落し、一時約６週間ぶりの安値を付けた。同社のクレジット・デフォルト・スワップ（ＣＤＳ） も過去最高水準に上昇している。投資家は、急成長する人工知能（ＡＩ）エージェント事業の恩恵と、野心的なＡＩ事業拡大に伴う資金負担の増大を見極めている。

マークイットのデータによると、同社の債務不履行に備える保証コストであるＣＤＳは、５年物スプレッドが７．６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）拡大し、過去最高の１１４．７９ｂｐとなった。１日の拡大幅としては少なくとも２０２５年以降で最大となる見通し。

２１日終値時点では、株価は２６年に入って５％超上昇していた。現在の下落幅が続けば、時価総額は約８５０億ドル減少する見通し。

メタが２１日に発表した第３・四半期決算は、売上高が６４６億ドルと、ＬＳＥＧが集計したアナリスト予想の６３３億７０００万ドルを上回った。第４・四半期の売上高見通しも市場予想を上回った。

また、２６年の設備投資見通しを１３５０億─１４５０億ドルとし、従来の１３００億─１４５０億ドルから下限を引き上げた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず 最終更新: 10/23(金) 1:12 ロイター

item.title: Top Democratic Virginia lawmaker charged by DOJ with running illegal cannabis operation
item.description: A senior Democratic state lawmaker in Virginia was charged with racketeering conspiracy, money laundering and other offenses for allegedly running an illegal cannabis business with members of her family, according to an indictment made public on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Goudsward
item.content:encoded: A senior Democratic state lawmaker in Virginia was charged with racketeering conspiracy, money laundering and other offenses for allegedly running an illegal cannabis business with members of her family, according to an indictment made public on Thursday. Virginia State Senator L. Louise Lucas, 82, a long-serving Democrat, was charged along with two of her daughters, her grandson and three others, according to the indictment. Prosecutors allege that Lucas and her associates arranged for the distribution and sale of large amounts of marijuana. Recreational cannabis dispensaries are not yet legally authorized in the state. The indictment of a senior Democratic lawmaker comes less than two weeks before the November midterm elections , which will determine control of the US Congress, though Lucas and other members of the Virginia state Senate are not up for reelection this year. The Justice Department under President Donald Trump has repeatedly investigated and, in some cases, prosecuted prominent critics of the Republican president, and the department faced criticism for raiding Democratic US Representative [USN:L1N45Y0CB TEXT:"Ilhan Omar's home"] last week. Attorney General Todd Blanche said the investigation into Lucas has been ongoing for several years, rejecting suggestions that it was politically motivated. "The charges listed in the indictment reflect the alleged behavior of a public servant who put her own financial interests before the people she was elected to serve," Blanche said during a press conference. In a statement posted to social media, Lucas did not address the allegations in the indictment, but said the case resulted from her standing up to "people in power." "I will not intimidated. I will not be bullied. And I will not back down," Lucas wrote. Lucas surrendered to authorities on Thursday morning and was due to make her first court appearance later in the day in Norfolk, Virginia, federal court. Lucas serves as president pro tempore of the state Senate, meaning she leads the legislative body when the lieutenant governor is not present. She played a leading role in Virginia's unsuccessful attempt to redraw its legislative districts last year in a bid to keep pace with Republicans who were leading similar efforts in other states.

item.title: Peru taps fiscal strength to face El Niño impact, eases fiscal rules
item.description: Peru on Thursday unveiled a package of economic measures aimed at cushioning a potential slowdown from the El Niño weather phenomenon.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Peru on Thursday unveiled a package of economic measures aimed at cushioning a potential slowdown from the El Niño weather phenomenon. Impacted firms will receive liquidity support and tax payment deferrals, Economy Minister Elmer Cuba said at a press conference, adding that Peru has the fiscal firepower to fund the measures. "Not all countries can do that - only solvent ones. The vast majority of the planet cannot respond like this," Cuba said Cuba cited three external shocks that could threaten Peru's economic momentum: El Niño, higher oil prices and rising global interest rates Peru's accumulated fiscal deficit in the 12 months through September stood at 0.9% of gross domestic product, the lowest level in four years, helped by stronger tax revenue, including income tax collections, according to preliminary central bank data Cuba also said Peru's economy could grow by more than the previously forecast 3.4%, even taking El Niño into account, though he did not give a revised estimate Scientist say that [USN:L6N43N0VE TEXT:"warmer ocean temperatures"] linked to the El Niño phenomenon are disrupting marine ecosystems off Peru's Pacific coast, threatening the country's fishing industry Speaking at the same press conference, President Keiko Fujimori said fiscal rules would be changed to allow an additional 18 billion soles ($5.22 billion) in investment next year Fujimori added that the change in fiscal rules contemplates raising the deficit to 2.4% of GDP in 2027, taking advantage of the public accounts' solidity, from the actual government's target of 1.8% for this year and 1.4% for 2027 ($1 = 3.4471 soles)

item.title: Anthropic IPO stands alone as AI market jitters sideline others
item.description: Anthropic plans to move forward with its initial public offering next month, navigating a challenging IPO landscape. While many companies in the AI field have delayed their public listings due to fluctuating interest rates and significant market instabilities, investors still see potential in Anthropic as a leading tech contender. Concerns are arising from the recent Oura IPO regarding institutional investor interest, emphasizing the heightened scrutiny on AI investment strategies.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A once-robust fall calendar for technology IPOs is down to just Anthropic.The AI lab is pressing ahead to hold its initial public offering as planned in the middle of next month after making its prospectus public as early as late October, people familiar with the matter said, cautioning the plan and the dates are subject to change.Anthropic's planned IPO will test whether its position at the center of the booming AI business, which the company is believed to deem worthy of a potential $1.5 trillion valuation, can overcome a market environment that might typically prompt bankers and deal lawyers to counsel delay. Anthropic is expected to begin marketing its shares to prospective investors during the week of November 9, one of the people said.For live updates on US Markets, click hereOther companies in the artificial intelligence infrastructure and data center sectors have delayed their listings, facing a rise in interest rates that has helped fuel a punishing selloff in shares and bonds of AI operators such as CoreWeave and broader questions about the sustainability of AI spending.The contrast underscores Anthropic's appeal to investors even as concerns about competition from open-source models and AI safety weigh on the sector.Many large investors remain bullish on Anthropic's prospects despite the fall turbulence, viewing the firm as one of the few opportunities to gain exposure to a technology sector that long-term investors cannot afford to ignore. Other issuers are reluctant to compete with Anthropic for institutional investors' attention and capital, two of the people said.Anthropic didn't immediately respond to a request for comment.VALUATIONS COMING UNDER PRESSUREThe AI sector pullback follows a string of IPO delays and withdrawals since September, as market volatility and rising interest rates have made it harder for companies to secure attractive valuations.Switch, a data center operator, and Nscale, an AI infrastructure provider, have pushed their IPO plans back to later this year, people familiar with the matter said, while stressing that plans remain fluid and subject to change. Nscale's delay was partly driven by the need to address comments from SEC staff, one other person said. SoftBank-backed SB Energy has also postponed its listing, Reuters previously reported.Switch, NScale and SB Energy didn't immediately respond to requests for comment.South Korean AI chip startup Elice was among the latest to shelve its listing plans overnight. Blackstone-backed AirTrunk REIT and Nvidia-backed Firmus have also pulled or paused their offerings, Reuters has reported.Oura's recent IPO has added to the caution among prospective issuers. The offering attracted little participation from long-only investors, a person familiar with the matter said, raising concerns about the depth of demand from institutional investors that typically provide a stable base of shareholders for newly listed companies.SCRUTINY ON MULTIPLE FRONTSThe retreat from AI infrastructure listings reflects growing scrutiny of the enormous capital required to build data centers and whether future demand will justify the investment.Recent developments involving CoreWeave have added to concerns about a potential slowdown in AI spending, although some market participants do not expect such a downturn to materialize.Nscale publicly filed its IPO registration statement in September, while Switch submitted its filing confidentially, Reuters reported previously. A confidential filing allows a company to work with regulators on its registration statement before disclosing financial and business details to the public. Companies typically publish the filing ahead of investor roadshows, when they begin marketing shares to prospective investors.

item.title: Perú anuncia política "contracíclica", con mayor déficit fiscal, para enfrentar a El Niño
item.description: Perú pondrá en marcha una política "contracíclica" elevando los topes de su meta de déficit fiscal para hacer mas inversiones y enfrentar choques externos en la economía local, como los efectos del fenómeno climático de El Niño, anunció el jueves el ministro de Economía del país sudamericano, Elmer Cuba.
item.dc:creator: Marco Aquino
item.content:encoded: Perú pondrá en marcha una política "contracíclica" elevando los topes de su meta de déficit fiscal para hacer mas inversiones y enfrentar choques externos en la economía local, como los efectos del fenómeno climático de El Niño, anunció el jueves el ministro de Economía del país sudamericano, Elmer Cuba. En una conferencia de prensa junto a la presidenta Keiko Fujimori, Cuba dijo que el Gobierno otorgará bonos a familias vulnerables, se inyectará liquidez y aplazarán pagos de impuestos a las empresas afectadas. El ministro dijo que el país minero tiene espacio fiscal para una respuesta frente a los choques externos, incluido el alza del petróleo y el aumento de las tasas de interés en el mundo. "Cada uno de estos choques amenaza el normal funcionamiento de cualquier economía y puede afectar el dinamismo de Perú, algo que no vamos a permitir porque tenemos espacio fiscal", manifestó Cuba. "No todos los países pueden hacer eso, solamente los países solventes", agregó. El déficit fiscal acumulado de Perú en los últimos 12 meses hasta septiembre fue del 0,9% del PIB, el más bajo en cuatro años, debido a mayores ingresos fiscales, según datos preliminares del banco central. Durante la conferencia de prensa, la presidenta Fujimori dijo que el Gobierno elevará los topes de la regla fiscal del 2027 para permitir la inversión de 18.000 millones de soles (unos 5.220 mil millones de dólares) más el próximo año. La mandataria detalló que, de ese monto, se destinarán 2.500 millones de soles en bonos para familias vulnerables, unos 2.000 millones de soles para el mantenimiento de la infraestructura y 13.000 millones de soles para culminar obras paralizadas. "La respuesta tiene que ser fuerte e histórica", afirmó. Fujimori dijo que el cambio de la regla fiscal contempla elevar el déficit a 2,4% del PBI en 2027, aprovechando la solidez de las cuentas públicas, desde la actual meta de un déficit fiscal de 1,8% este año y 1,4% el próximo. El Gobierno dijo recientemente que la temperatura del mar en Perú ha llegado a sus niveles máximos en esta época del año, lo que hace prever que enfrentará el fenómeno climático de El Niño [USN:L1N4620VD TEXT:"más poderoso"] de las últimas décadas. "Será un Niño sin precedente en los últimos 70 años", dijo Cuba, quien, sin embargo, agregó que la economía del país podría crecer este año más del 3,4% que espera el gobierno, aunque no proporcionó una nueva cifra. El Niño ya está afectando a la industria de la pesca, a la agricultura y está presionando los precios. Por otra parte, se prevé que lluvias e inundaciones dañen infraestructura como carreteras y servicios básicos. A mediados de septiembre, el Banco Central de Perú [USN:L1N45A0RI TEXT:"redujo su proyección de crecimiento"] para la economía del país minero a un 3,2% en 2026, desde el 3,4% que había previsto, debido a los efectos de El Niño. (1 dólar = 3,45 soles)

item.title: CSN, Vale, Braskem e outras indústrias compram gás em leilão inédito da PPSA
item.description: A siderúrgica CSN , a mineradora Vale e a petroquímica Braskem , entre outras grandes companhias industriais, venceram lotes de gás natural da União ofertados em leilão inédito do insumo realizado pela Pré-Sal Petróleo (PPSA) nesta quinta-feira, segundo dados da plataforma do certame.
item.dc:creator: Leticia Augusto
item.content:encoded: A siderúrgica CSN (CSNA3.SA) , a mineradora Vale (VALE3.SA) e a petroquímica Braskem (BRKM3.SA) , entre outras grandes companhias industriais, venceram lotes de gás natural da União ofertados em leilão inédito do insumo realizado pela Pré-Sal Petróleo (PPSA) nesta quinta-feira, segundo dados da plataforma do certame. O primeiro leilão para venda direta de gás à indústria brasileira terminou com todo o volume oferecido, de 1,1 milhão m³/dia dividido em 110 lotes, arrematado por 23 empresas de cinco setores grandes consumidores de gás. O preço médio do gás negociado ficou em US$5,83/MMBtu, o que, segundo uma autoridade do Ministério de Minas e Energia, proporcionará às indústrias participantes reduções de 38% a 57% frente à média de US$12/MMBtu usada como referência de mercado. No setor químico e petroquímico, que contou com o maior volume de gás disponibilizado, de 350 mil m³/dia, foram vencedoras a Braskem (BRKM3.SA) , Rhodia, Evonik, Ingredion e Peróxidos do Brasil. Entre as siderúrgicas, metalúrgicas e mineradoras, com 320 mil m³/dia de gás ofertado, foram vencedoras CSN, Gerdau Aços Longos, Samarco, Ternium Brasil e Vale. Também contrataram gás a Yara Fertilizantes e Multitécnica Industrial, do setor de fertilizantes nitrogenados, com 130 mil m³/dia, e outras 11 empresas dos setores ceramista (200 mil m³/dia) e vidreiro (100 mil m³/dia). Em relação a preços, os menores lances foram de US$4,00/MMBtu para o setor vidreiro, US$1,86/MMBtu para o ceramista, US$2,30/MMBtu para o siderúrgico, metalúrgico e de mineração, US$1,92/MMBtu para químico e petroquímico e US$1,82/MMBtu para fertilizantes nitrogenados. Os lances tiveram uma referência inicial de US$1,80/MMBtu para todas as disputas. Com fornecimento entre março e dezembro de 2027, o gás vendido neste leilão será entregue no Complexo de Energias Boaventura da Petrobras, o antigo Comperj, em Itaboraí (RJ). A partir dali, cada comprador contrata o transporte por gasodutos até suas fábricas. DEMANDA REPRIMIDA O leilão da PPSA é o primeiro de venda direta a consumidores do gás natural pertencente à União. A iniciativa buscou ampliar o número de agentes no mercado de gás e contribuir para a competitividade da indústria brasileira. "O que o dia de hoje comprovou foi que a demanda (por gás) não só existe, mas você tem setores industriais ávidos por adquirir o gás natural a um preço competitivo, com uma formação de preço em leilão", disse Renato Dutra, secretário de Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis do Ministério de Minas e Energia. Segundo ele, as reduções de dois dígitos de preço mostram que é possível fazer política pública com o gás da União, ajudando na competitividade da indústria nacional, "com um preço justo e adequado no sentido de remunerar as infraestruturas (de escoamento e processamento de gás)". Segundo o presidente da PPSA, Luis Fernando Paroli, o Brasil terá um [USN:L1N4680YA TEXT:"novo leilão"] de gás natural da União à indústria em 2027, com oferta de 1,8 milhão de metros cúbicos por dia.

Oct 22 : Bayern Munich forward Luis Diaz will be out of action for the "foreseeable future" after suffering a minor muscle tear in his left hamstring during Wednesday's 2-2 Champions League draw with visiting Arsenal, the Bundesliga club said on Thursday. The 29-year-old Colombia international came on in the 68th minute at the Allianz Arena but was forced off in stoppage time after suffering the injury. Examinations carried out by Bayern's medical staff confirmed the hamstring tear, the club said in a statement. "The 29-year-old forward will therefore be sidelined for the time being," Bayern said.

FAST

Oct 22 : Cable production capacity is emerging as a bottleneck for AI-driven data centre construction, Nexans' finance chief said, as demand rises faster than the industry's ability to expand manufacturing capacity. Global cable capacity is tight and building a new cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) cable production line, known in the industry as a CV line, takes around three years, limiting how quickly suppliers can respond to demand, Nexans CFO Vincent Piquet told Reuters. "Things can't move quickly and the people building these data centres are in a great hurry," Piquet said. Data centres require large amounts of low- and medium-voltage cable to connect power infrastructure, with larger facilities consuming proportionately more medium-voltage cable.

The strain on power infrastructure is already delaying some projects. In September, Oracle issued a force majeure notice to a Blue Owl unit developing a large data centre in New Mexico, citing potential difficulties securing sufficient power for the site. Piquet said grid constraints, while slowing some projects, were also supporting demand for Nexans' products and allowing the company to be more selective when allocating capacity. French distribution network operator Enedis has moved from annual procurement agreements to contracts lasting six or seven years in order to secure cable supply, he said. While Europe generally faces fewer grid-connection challenges than the United States and benefits from stronger electricity networks in some northern countries, Piquet said lengthy regulatory processes were delaying certain projects. He said he did not expect demand linked to artificial intelligence to slow, although Europe's data-centre expansion was likely to be less pronounced than in the United States because private investment capacity was smaller and public funding played a larger role.

item.title: Líder da oposição do Equador González é presa por supostas irregularidades em financiamento de campanha
item.description: Uma proeminente política de esquerda do Equador, que ficou em segundo lugar nas duas últimas eleições, atrás do presidente Daniel Noboa, foi presa, informou nesta quinta-feira a chefe de seu partido.
item.dc:creator: Alexandra Valencia
item.content:encoded: Uma proeminente política de esquerda do Equador, que ficou em segundo lugar nas duas últimas eleições, atrás do presidente Daniel Noboa, foi presa, informou nesta quinta-feira a chefe de seu partido. Luisa González, protegida do ex-presidente socialista Rafael Correa, está sendo investigada por supostas irregularidades no financiamento político e nos gastos de campanha nas eleições de 2023. Em uma postagem no X, González disse que a acusação era “absurda” e pediu união aos membros de seu partido para alcançar a liberdade e a democracia no Equador. A líder do partido Revolução Cidadã, Gabriela Rivadeneira, confirmou a prisão em uma postagem nas redes sociais e argumentou que ela teve motivação política. “Exigimos a libertação imediata de Luisa González, que não deveria ter que enfrentar um processo de perseguição e tortura imposto por este governo”, disse ela aos repórteres. Em um vídeo publicado nas redes sociais, a Procuradoria-Geral informou que a investigação buscava esclarecer a origem dos recursos utilizados para financiar a propaganda eleitoral entre maio e agosto de 2023. “Uma rede de pessoas jurídicas foi utilizada para canalizar aproximadamente US$500.000 para contratar e adquirir publicidade de campanha. Os recursos teriam sido canalizados sem a divulgação de sua origem ou da identidade dos contribuintes”, afirmou o vídeo. Rivadeneira afirmou que os recursos da campanha de 2023 foram totalmente contabilizados e que as multas financeiras impostas anteriormente pela autoridade eleitoral já haviam sido pagas, reiterando declarações anteriores de González. O ex-presidente Correa, que apoiou a candidatura de González, também contestou as alegações. “Não se trata de legalidade, nem de se as regras estão sendo seguidas ou não. Trata-se de uma perseguição brutal e simples”, disse ele em um programa de rádio local. A Procuradoria-Geral do Equador, em uma postagem nas redes sociais, informou que sete pessoas estão sob investigação por “inconsistências nas contribuições e na origem lícita dos recursos” durante a campanha presidencial de 2023. Três pessoas foram presas até o momento e responderão a acusações por suposta lavagem de dinheiro, informou o órgão, sem revelar seus nomes completos. González perdeu as eleições de 2023 e 2025 para Noboa e alegou fraude na derrota do ano passado. Ela tentou concorrer às eleições locais marcadas para 29 de novembro, mas não conseguiu registrar sua candidatura devido às regras de registro dos partidos.

item.description:
