問題の広告は、民主党候補エイミー・アクトン氏と疎遠になっている母親ドナ・アーサー氏が登場し、幼少期にホームレス生活を送り、性的虐待を受けたというアクトン氏の主張にアーサー氏が異議を唱える内容となっている。アクトン氏によると、１９７８年以来会っていないというアーサー氏は、オハイオ州民に対しアクトン氏に投票しないよう訴えている。
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Helen Coster

[２２日　ロイター] - バンス米副大統領は２２日、オハイオ州知事選で共和党候補のビベック・ラマスワミ氏の陣営が民主党のライバル候補に対して展開した攻撃広告を擁護した。また、共和党議員に対して「泣き言を言うのはやめて」、選挙に勝つよう呼びかけた。

問題の広告は、民主党候補エイミー・アクトン氏と疎遠になっている母親ドナ・アーサー氏が登場し、幼少期にホームレス生活を送り、性的虐待を受けたというアクトン氏の主張にアーサー氏が異議を唱える内容となっている。アクトン氏によると、１９７８年以来会っていないというアーサー氏は、オハイオ州民に対しアクトン氏に投票しないよう訴えている。 アクトン氏は、１２歳の時に継父から性的虐待を受けたと主張している。

この広告は広く非難を浴びており、品位を欠く中間選挙戦の様相を浮き彫りにした。トランプ大統領の大統領選以降、右傾化が進んだオハイオ州において、ラマスワミ氏や他の共和党候補にとって逆効果となる可能性がある。

こうした中、バンス氏は２２日、ラマスワミ氏や共和党のジョン・ハステッド上院議員と共に演説を行い、こうした反発を一蹴した。

バンス氏は、ラマスワミ氏との集会に先立ちシンシナティで、「共和党の同僚議員たちへの私のメッセージはこうだ。自分が信じていると述べているものを本当に信じるのなら、広告について泣き言を言うのはやめて、残り１３日の選挙戦で勝利を収めるべきだ」と強調。

その上で「皆さんへの私のメッセージは非常にシンプルだ。テレビ広告についてどう思おうと、その内容と事実に注目してほしい」と述べた。

この広告は当初、スポンサー表記のないまま２１日に交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）に公開されたが、その後、ラマスワミ氏の陣営が制作元であることを認め、広告の宣伝のために４００万ドルを投じていると説明した明らかにした。

トランプ氏は２２日、広告について何も知らないと語った。

item.title: South Africa’s Trade With China Surges After Beijing’s Zero-Tariff Deal
item.description: South Africa’s trade with China has increased since Beijing introduced a temporary zero-tariff scheme for qualifying South African exports in May, offering Pretoria an opportunity to expand sales to its largest trading partner as relations with the United States come under increasing strain. South African …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
South Africa’s trade with China has increased since Beijing introduced a temporary zero-tariff scheme for qualifying South African exports in May, offering Pretoria an opportunity to expand sales to its largest trading partner as relations with the United States come under increasing strain.

South African exports to China rose nearly 25% year over year between May and August, while imports from China increased 23% over the same period, Chinese Ambassador Wu Peng said at an event in Pretoria on Thursday.

South Africa has been seeking to rebalance its trade with China, which is its largest trading partner. In 2025, South Africa exported about 222 billion rand ($13.5 billion) worth of goods to China and imported nearly twice that amount, Trade Minister Parks Tau said.

South Africa’s exports to China include agricultural products, minerals and manufactured goods. The government is seeking to expand access for higher-value products as it looks to narrow the trade imbalance and diversify its export markets.

Wu said he had heard South Africa’s concerns about the imbalance in bilateral trade and expressed confidence that Chinese market access for South African products would expand.

“I am confident more and more South African high value-added products will enter the Chinese market in the future,” he said.

China’s zero-tariff preference scheme took effect on May 1, 2026, and is scheduled to run through April 30, 2028, pending a broader economic partnership arrangement between China and African countries. The temporary measure covers qualifying South African exports that meet applicable rules of origin and documentation requirements, while certain products are subject to tariff-rate quotas.

The arrangement provides South African exporters with an opportunity to compete in the Chinese market without paying customs duties on eligible goods. However, the increase in trade recorded since May does not establish how much of the growth resulted directly from the tariff changes.

For Pretoria, expanding exports to China is part of a broader effort to develop alternative markets as uncertainty over access to the U.S. market threatens an established source of export demand.

The United States has extended the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA), which gives eligible sub-Saharan African countries duty-free access to the U.S. market for thousands of products, through 2028. South Africa, however, faces the risk of exclusion as President Donald Trump’s administration has criticized several of its domestic and foreign policies.

The Trump administration has accused the South African government of persecuting white people, an allegation Pretoria denies.

South African President Cyril Ramaphosa said on October 19 that the country must prepare for the possibility of losing its AGOA benefits, as his government pursues alternative markets and holds discussions with U.S. counterparts.

Tau said he expected an announcement in early November on whether South Africa would be excluded from the program, but remained “cautiously optimistic.”

The uncertainty has added urgency to South Africa’s efforts to diversify its export destinations, including through stronger commercial ties with China. However, expanding trade with Beijing does not necessarily guarantee a reduction in the bilateral trade imbalance, particularly as imports from China are also rising.

South Africa’s ability to benefit from the Chinese scheme will depend partly on whether domestic producers can increase exports of qualifying goods and move into higher-value agricultural, industrial and processed products. The tariff preference removes customs duties on eligible exports but does not eliminate other market-access requirements.

The two countries’ trade figures point to expanding commercial ties, but the challenge for Pretoria will be to translate that growth into greater export earnings and a more balanced trading relationship.

With a decision on South Africa’s AGOA eligibility expected in early November, the country faces pressure to strengthen its position in China and other markets while seeking to preserve preferential access to the United States.

item.title: 米ブラックストーン、第3四半期13％減益 市場混乱が逆風
item.description: [２２日 ロイター] - 米大手投資会社ブラックストーンが２２日発表した第３・四半期決算は減益となった。市場環境の混乱...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ブラックストーン、第3四半期13％減益　市場混乱が逆風 10/22 23:26 配信

2025年7月29日撮影。REUTERS/Mike Segar

[２２日 ロイター] - 米大手投資会社ブラックストーンが２２日発表した第３・四半期決算は減益となった。市場環境の混乱が投資回収の重荷となった。

世界の市場は、債券利回りの急上昇や高金利の長期化観測、イラン戦争に伴う相場変動の拡大で動揺している。

この結果、多くの案件が保留となり、２０２６年上半期の取引や新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）は減速した。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、第３・四半期の世界のＭ＆Ａ（合併・買収）は前四半期比４１％減少した。

ブラックストーンの投資回収に伴う収益は３４％減の約３億３２００万ドルとなった。プライベートエクイティ（ＰＥ）事業で５０％近く減少したことが響いた。

分配可能利益（株主に還元可能な利益）は１株当たり１．３２ドルと１３％減少した。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想の平均は１．２６ドルだった。

一方、６３０億ドルを超える資金の純流入が業績を下支えした。運用資産残高は１兆３７００億ドルに拡大し、手数料関連利益は６％増加した。

新規の資金流入はクレジット・保険事業が約３６０億ドルと最大で、ＰＥ事業が１２６億ドルで続いた。

ＰＥファンドの運用による手数料関連利益は２６％増の６億１９００万ドルとなった。

オルタナティブ資産運用各社の株価は２６年に入り下落している。今後の成長鈍化の見通しや、人工知能（ＡＩ）の進歩が投資先企業の事業に混乱をもたらす可能性に対し、投資家が慎重姿勢を強めたためだ。

特にプライベートクレジットに対する投資家の不安は強く、大手運用各社はここ数四半期にわたり解約請求の急増を報告している。

ブラックストーンは９月、同社のファンド「ＢＣＲＥＤ」への解約請求が第３・四半期も高水準にとどまったと明らかにした。ただ、投資先のファンダメンタルズ（基礎的条件）は引き続き健全だとの見解を維持している。

同社株は２６年に入り３０％近く急落し、他の資産運用会社とおおむね同様の値動きとなっている。一方、市場全体は１３％、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００金融株指数は約２％上昇している。

item.title: Detienen a excandidata ecuatoriana Luisa González por acusación sobre fondos electorales
item.description: La dirigencia del partido izquierdista ecuatoriano Revolución Ciudadana informó sobre la detención en la madrugada del jueves de Luisa González, principal rival del presidente Daniel Noboa en las dos últimas elecciones, que calificó la acusación de "abusrda".
item.dc:creator: Alexandra Valencia
item.content:encoded: La dirigencia del partido izquierdista ecuatoriano Revolución Ciudadana informó sobre la detención en la madrugada del jueves de Luisa González, principal rival del presidente Daniel Noboa en las dos últimas elecciones, que calificó la acusación de "abusrda". González, una protegida del expresidente socialista Rafael Correa, es investigada, juntos a otros miembros de su partido, por presuntas irregularidades en la financiación política y los gastos de campaña del 2023. "Hoy me toca a mi ser detenida por una acusación absurda", escribió González en una carta publicado en su cuenta de X. "Los presos políticos de la dictadura están siendo maltratados y torturados". "Hemos llegado a una situación insostenible", añadió. La presidenta del partido Revolución Ciudadana, Gabriela Rivadeneira, dijo a periodistas que los fondos de la campaña de 2023 fueron debidamente justificados y que las sanciones económicas impuestas antes por la autoridad electoral ya habían sido pagadas, reiterando así declaraciones previas de la propia González. El movimiento político exigió la inmediata libertad de González ante la falta de pruebas en su contra. Correa, quien respaldó la candidatura de González, también rechazó las acusaciones. “Aquí no se trata de legalidad (...) es brutal y simple persecución y frente a eso sólo queda resistir de todas formas posibles", dijo a Radio Pichincha. "A Luisa la van a enterrar en vida". La Fiscalía General del Estado informó de que siete personas están siendo investigadas en relación con este caso —tres de ellas detenidas, de quienes solo se proporcionaron sus iniciales— y añadió que en las próximas horas presentará cargos por presunto lavado de activos. Más tarde, la institución explicó que además de los fondos declarados ante la autoridad electoral, se habrían utilizado "un entramado" de personas jurídicas para canalizar aproximadamente 500.000 dólares para la campaña electoral, de acuerdo a lo recabado en la investigación. "Los fondos se habrían canalizado sin trasparentar su procedencia ni la identidad de quienes habrían aportado”, añadió la fiscalía en un video publicado en redes sociales. González perdió frente a Noboa tanto en las elecciones de 2023 como en las de 2025. Tras la derrota del año pasado, denunció un supuesto fraude. Intentó postularse en los comicios seccionales del 29 de noviembre, pero no pudo inscribirse por las normas de registro de partidos políticos.

BRUSSELS, Oct 22 : Digital advertisers and publishers lobbied on Thursday for EU and UK regulators to suspend Meta Platforms' new commercial terms due to come into effect on October 30, alleging that these would give Meta an unlimited right to use their content for its AI services. Advocacy group the Movement for an Open Web, whose members include digital advertisers and publishers, said it had complained to the European Commission and the UK's Competition and Markets Authority and requested interim measures. Publishers worldwide are stepping up their fight with AI companies that use their content without permission to train large language models, underscoring the clash between copyright owners and those citing fair use arguments. "Meta's new terms are clearly anti-competitive. Many businesses effectively have no choice but to use Meta's services and these conditions would force them to sign away the rights to their digital content with no means of opting out," Tim Cowen, co-founder of the Movement for an Open Web, said.

"The terms would give Meta a free hand to scrape content from nearly every website in the world, potentially using that data to power AI-powered services that would then compete with those businesses," he said. Meta said it disagreed with the complaint. "The crawling terms we consolidated only applied to our ads and business products, and we've clarified that in the terms themselves. It does not change how Meta uses web crawlers," a Meta spokesperson said. "As always, content owners can use robots.txt to signal their preferences. This is not about scraping news sites, and these updates don't give us new rights that supersede those preferences." The CMA said it met with Meta on Wednesday to get more details on its new business terms. "This is an important issue and we recognise the concerns that have been raised by businesses in the UK. We are engaged in urgent discussions with Meta as we consider our next steps," a CMA spokesperson said. The European Commission said it has received a complaint which it would assess in line with its usual procedure and that it was committed to ensuring that Meta's practices comply with EU laws.  Companies requesting interim measures have to show that they will suffer serious and irreparable damage from the alleged anti-competitive practices. The criticism by the Movement for an Open Web followed similar complaints aired by the European Publishers Council (EPC) last week and Germany's Digital Publishers and Newspaper Publishers Association (BDZV) and the Association of the Free Press (MVFP) earlier this week.

Source: Reuters

Oct 22 : Nippon Steel will invest about $3 billion in the U.S. Steel-operated Mon Valley works in Pennsylvania to upgrade the plant's hot rolling facility, the Nikkei newspaper reported on Thursday. The move is part of the Japanese steelmaker's pledge to invest $11 billion in U.S. Steel by 2028, following its acquisition of the company in 2025. Nippon Steel did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment outside regular business hours. Mon Valley's hot rolling equipment, which heats slabs of iron from blast furnaces and rolls them into thinner steel, has been in operation for about 90 years, Nikkei added. The new equipment is set to enter operation in the second half of 2029, which would enable production of higher-quality steel, the report said. Nippon Steel raised its fiscal 2026 earnings forecast in August, lifted by stronger U.S. Steel earnings and a firm steel market.

Source: Reuters

Yet researchers working off Costa Rica found their movements are varied, with juveniles staying nearby and close to shore while adults venture hundreds of kilometres.Manta rays are among the ocean'

FAST

Oct 22 : Anyone who has watched a manta ray glide over a reef knows how unhurried these marine animals can look. Yet researchers working off Costa Rica found their movements are varied, with juveniles staying nearby and close to shore while adults venture hundreds of kilometres. Manta rays are among the ocean's largest fish, with wing-like fins that can span up to about 8 meters (26 feet) and the largest brain of any fish. Researchers tracked endangered oceanic manta rays between 2018 and 2025, fitting 59 of them with acoustic transmitters and tracking 12 with satellite tags, along with photo identification.  "By combining different technologies ... we were able to piece together a highly detailed map of their movements and their use of coastal cleaning stations," said Jeffry Madrigal-Mesén, director of the research group Mantas Costa Rica and lead author of the study published in the journal Frontiers in Fish Science.

A coastal cleaning station is a rocky reef site where small fish remove parasites from the skin of the manta rays in an example of symbiotic behaviour. Researchers found that smaller, immature mantas stayed within Costa Rica's coastal waters, called its exclusive economic zone. Larger, mature animals undertook long-distance journeys, some reaching as far as the waters off Guatemala. "This makes us believe that smaller mantas do not risk these long migrations, likely due to the threat of large predators like orcas and tiger sharks," Madrigal-Mesén said. The smaller animals in the study measured around 3 to 3.5 meters across (10 to 11.5 feet), compared with around 4 to 4.5 meters (13 to 15 feet) for those making the longer journeys. DANGER FROM PREDATORS A juvenile, at around 3 meters across, would still appear enormous to most swimmers. Yet that size may not be enough protection. Madrigal-Mesén said that "their massive size is one of their main defence mechanisms. It is quite common to see animals missing portions of their bodies, and in many cases, the shape of the wounds strongly suggests they are bites from other large marine predators." What prompts mantas to eventually join the migratory population remains unclear, although researchers suspect that reaching feeding and breeding grounds in highly productive waters across Central America may play a role. The manta rays also repeatedly return to the same coastal cleaning stations. Observations of feeding, courtship and recent mating suggest these sites may also function as social hubs. Scientists do not yet know how mantas navigate back to particular sites. "Based on the bathymetry of the different sites we monitor, there must be a relationship with the rock formations. We humans have favourite places we like to go to," Madrigal-Mesén said. "Why couldn't mantas have a preference for one cleaning station over another?" The findings also suggest the mantas may not roam as far as once thought. Researchers initially suspected that animals seen in Costa Rica might migrate from populations in Ecuador or Mexico. The tracking data instead raises the possibility that Central America has its own distinct population, something the team is now investigating through genetic work. Mantas are particularly vulnerable because, like other rays and sharks, they reproduce slowly and take years to reach sexual maturity. Madrigal-Mesén said that once the animals left Cocos Island, a volcanic island in the Pacific Ocean, and most monitored coastal sites, they entered waters with no protection, exposing them to threats including fishing and vessel traffic. "Studies like this help us recognise that these coastal havens only protect them for a specific time of the year. ... This is why it is so critical to protect the marine corridors these migratory species travel through." Coastal mantas also showed strong site fidelity, with very few moving between monitoring sites even when they were only tens of kilometres apart.  One male became a particularly striking example. Nicknamed "Mickey Mouse" for its distinctive spot pattern, the ray was repeatedly photographed at Cabo Blanco and tracked using both satellite and acoustic tags, showing a strong attachment to the site.  But researchers have not seen this ray in Costa Rica for more than a year.  "We have a lot of affection for him," Madrigal-Mesén added. "We hope he comes back soon."

Source: Reuters

item.title: Ecuadorean opposition leader Gonzalez arrested over alleged irregularities in campaign financing
item.description: A prominent leftist politician in Ecuador who was runner-up to President Daniel Noboa in the last two elections has been arrested, the head of her party said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Alexandra Valencia
item.content:encoded: A prominent leftist politician in Ecuador who was runner-up to President Daniel Noboa in the last two elections has been arrested, the head of her party said on Thursday. Luisa Gonzalez, a protege of former socialist President Rafael Correa, is under investigation over alleged irregularities in political financing and campaign spending in the 2023 election. In a post on X, Gonzalez said the accusation was "absurd" and she asked for unity from members of her party to reach freedom and democracy in Ecuador. The head of the Citizens' Revolution party, Gabriela Rivadeneira, confirmed the arrest in a social media post and argued it was politically motivated. "We demand the immediate release of Luisa Gonzalez, who should not have to face a process of persecution and torture imposed by this government," she told reporters. In a video posted on social media, the Attorney General's Office said the investigation was seeking to clarify the source of the funds used to finance election advertising between May and August 2023. "A network of legal entities was used to channel approximately $500,000 to contract and purchase campaign advertising. The funds were allegedly channelled without disclosing their source or the identity of those who contributed them,” it said in a video. Rivadeneira said the 2023 campaign funds were fully accounted for and prior financial penalties imposed by the electoral authority had been paid, echoing earlier statements from Gonzalez. Former President Correa, who backed Gonzalez's candidacy, also disputed the allegations. "This is not about legality, or whether the rules are being followed or not. It is brutal and simple persecution," he told a local radio program. The Ecuadorean Attorney General's Office in a social media post said seven people are under investigation over "inconsistencies in the contributions and the lawful source of the funds" during the 2023 presidential campaign. Three people so far have been arrested and will face charges for alleged money laundering, it said, without providing their full names. Gonzalez lost both the 2023 and 2025 elections to Noboa, and alleged fraud in last year's loss. She had attempted to run in local elections set for November 29 but was unable to register her candidacy due to party registration rules.

FAST

Oct 22 : The cost of insuring Meta Platforms' debt against default touched an all-time high on Thursday, as investors grappled with concerns about its plan to spend more on its AI build-out. Meta raised the lower end of its annual forecast for capital expenditure to between $135 billion and $145 billion this year, up from $130 billion to $145 billion expected previously. As a result, five-year credit default swaps widened 7.6 basis points to a record high of 114.79 bps and were set for its biggest one-day jump since at least 2025, Markit data showed. Its shares were last down 6.1 per cent at $655, hitting their lowest in about six weeks. Meta also introduced new non-voting shares and reported a free cash flow deficit of $2.12 billion in the third quarter, turning cash flow negative for the first time since 2012.

"The market has been questioning whether all the spending on AI is having the type of returns that the market originally expected," said Steve Sosnick, chief market analyst at Interactive Brokers. "In Meta's case, investors are interpreting the new non-voting shares as a backdoor for issuing more stock and diluting holdings eventually so I think that's adding to this aggressive selloff." Investors are growing more cautious about debt-fueled AI spending in the face of rising borrowing costs, with neocloud firm CoreWeave at the center of a storm that has erased more than 34 per cent of its market value this month. CoreWeave shares slumped 8.4 per cent on Thursday, while rival Nebius Group and data center operators IREN and Applied Digital also saw heavy losses. US chip stocks, widely viewed as one of the biggest winners of the AI boom, also sold off heavily with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index set to erase more than $688 billion in market value on Thursday alone. Five-year credit default swaps of hyperscaler Oracle were also close to a record high, while that of Amazon.com held near its highest level since March 2020, according to S&P Global Market Intelligence data. Oracle and Alphabet shares dropped more than 2 per cent, while Microsoft slipped 1.3 per cent and Amazon fell 3.7 per cent.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米新規失業保険申請6000件減の19.4万件、約57年ぶり低水準に迫る

item.content:encoded:
米新規失業保険申請6000件減の19.4万件、約57年ぶり低水準に迫る 10/22 22:46 配信

米バージニア州アーリントンにある店舗に掲げられた求人看板。2023年4月撮影。REUTERS/Elizabeth Frantz

[ワシントン　２２日　ロイター] - 米労働省が２２日発表した１０月１７日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は前週比６０００件減の１９万４０００件となった。レイオフ（一時解雇）の少なさを背景に、申請件数は１９６９年以来の低水準となった７月中旬の１８万９０００件に迫る水準にある。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は２０万件だった。

週ごとの変動をならした４週間移動平均は１０００件減の１９万７７５０件と、１９６９年以来の低水準となった。

エコノミストらは、堅調な内需を背景に企業収益が伸びていることに加え、退職の増加やトランプ政権による移民取り締まりで労働力人口が縮小していることが、労働者を解雇から守っていると指摘している。ただ、中東紛争の長期化に伴う金融環境の引き締めや金利上昇が、来年の労働市場に悪影響を及ぼす恐れがあるとの懸念もある。

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「政権の移民政策により労働市場は逼迫し、企業は財（モノ）・サービスの生産に必要な人手を確保できなくなっているため、既存の労働者を手放さない状況になっている」と指摘。「多くの産業において、突如として労働者が代替不可能な存在となっている」と述べた。

今回の申請件数データは、１０月の雇用統計の調査期間と重なっている。

１０月１０日までの１週間の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は２万５０００件増の１７２万８０００件となった。 ただ、継続受給件数には、大学を最近卒業した人や、職歴が浅い、または全くないために受給資格がない人は含まれていない。

長期失業者の一部が、大半の州で２６週間に制限されている受給資格を使い果たした可能性もあり、これが継続受給件数が低水準で推移する一因となっている可能性がある。９月の失業期間の中央値は１１．５週と、約４年半ぶりの高水準に近いものの、９月の失業率は４．２％にとどまっており、労働市場がインフレの要因とはなっていない。

ハイ・フリークエンシー・エコノミクスのチーフエコノ ミスト、カール・ワインバーグ氏は「米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は、需要を抑制しスラック（需給の緩み）を拡大して、インフレ目標回帰を確実にするために金融引き締めが必要と判断すれば、来週にも自由に利上げに踏み切ることができる」と指摘。「雇用に関するＦＲＢの責務は明らかに満たされている」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：ＡＩ信奉の誤算、米メタ　大規模リストラ縮小し「人間中心」に回帰 アングル：米雇用統計、利下げ観測復活の試金石に　ＦＲＢはなお慎重 アングル：3月米雇用統計、ＦＲＢの金利据え置きシナリオの補強要因に 焦点：ＡＩが10万人以上の雇用に影響か、米映画業界でリスキリング活況 アングル：試される米消費の持続力、物価高に政府閉鎖や雇用情勢悪化で 最終更新: 10/23(金) 0:09 ロイター

FAST

Oct 22 : A once-robust fall calendar for technology IPOs is down to just Anthropic.  The AI lab is pressing ahead to hold its initial public offering as planned in the middle of next month after making its  prospectus public as early as late October, people familiar with the matter said, cautioning the plan and the dates are subject to change.  Anthropic's planned IPO will test whether its position at the center of the booming AI business, which some investors believe to deem worthy of a potential $1.5 trillion valuation, can overcome a market environment that might typically prompt bankers and deal lawyers to counsel delay. Anthropic is expected to begin marketing its shares to prospective investors during the week of November 9, one of the people said.  Other companies in the artificial intelligence infrastructure and data center sectors have delayed their listings, facing a rise in interest rates that has helped fuel a punishing selloff in shares and bonds of AI operators such as CoreWeave and broader questions about the sustainability of AI spending.

The contrast underscores Anthropic's appeal to investors even as concerns about competition from open-source models and AI safety weigh on the sector.  Many  large investors remain bullish on Anthropic’s prospects despite the fall turbulence, viewing the firm as one of the few opportunities to gain exposure to a technology sector that long-term investors cannot afford to ignore. Other issuers are reluctant to compete with Anthropic for institutional investors' attention and capital, two of the people said. Anthropic declined to comment. VALUATIONS COMING UNDER PRESSURE The AI sector pullback follows a string of IPO delays and withdrawals since September, as market volatility and rising interest rates have made it harder for companies to secure attractive valuations. Switch, a data center operator, and Nscale, an AI infrastructure provider, have pushed their IPO plans back to later this year, people familiar with the matter said, while stressing that plans remain fluid and subject to change. Nscale’s delay was partly driven by the need to address comments from SEC staff, one other person said. SoftBank-backed SB Energy has also postponed its listing, Reuters previously reported. NScale declined to comment. Switch didn't immediately respond to a request for comment. South Korean AI chip startup Elice was among the latest to shelve its listing plans overnight. Blackstone-backed AirTrunk REIT and Nvidia-backed Firmus have also pulled or paused their offerings, Reuters has reported. Oura's recent IPO has added to the caution among prospective issuers. The offering attracted little participation from long-only investors, a person familiar with the matter said, raising concerns about the depth of demand from institutional investors that typically provide a stable base of shareholders for newly listed companies. SCRUTINY ON MULTIPLE FRONTS The retreat from AI infrastructure listings reflects growing scrutiny of the enormous capital required to build data centers and whether future demand will justify the investment. Recent developments involving CoreWeave have added to concerns about a potential slowdown in AI spending, although some market participants do not expect such a downturn to materialize. Nscale publicly filed its IPO registration statement in September, while Switch submitted its filing confidentially, Reuters reported previously. A confidential filing allows a company to work with regulators on its registration statement before disclosing financial and business details to the public. Companies typically publish the filing ahead of investor roadshows, when they begin marketing shares to prospective investors.

Source: Reuters

WASHINGTON, Oct 22 : The US Commerce Department said on Thursday it plans to award $389 million in research and development funding to four companies working on power semiconductor devices and critical materials to boost technologies like commercial fusion. As a condition of funding, the US government will receive minority, non-controlling and non-voting equity stakes, the department said. In recent months, it has awarded 19 R&D grants to semiconductor firms from a $10 billion fund approved by Congress in 2022. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said in a statement the awards will "accelerate American semiconductor innovation to enhance our domestic energy and power resources." Reuters first reported the new funding. The department said it had signed letters of intent to provide four new awards:

• Washington-based Helion will receive up to $175 million to develop high-voltage power semiconductors and advanced energy power modules in fusion power generation. The semiconductors will power and use energy from magnets driving Helion fusion generators. Helion said the award will be accompanied by $50 million in new private investment funds. "Building fusion power plants at scale requires us to accelerate the development of technologies like semiconductors that are critical to making fusion possible,” said Helion CEO David Kirtley. • Massachusetts-based Commonwealth Fusion Systems will receive up to $85 million to develop semiconductors for radio-frequency plasma heating, power electronics, fusion diagnostics, and radiation-hardened electronics. • Commonwealth said the funding will help develop semiconductor technologies for robotic maintenance systems. "These innovations will be a vital part of our global effort to deploy commercial fusion," Commonwealth CEO Bob Mumgaard said. • Vertical Semiconductor will receive up to $73 million to advance its vertical gallium nitride power semiconductors for use in AI data center racks. The company, a startup spun out of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, said the funding will help accelerate R&D of next-generation power transistors and speed domestic production of this technology to drastically improve efficiency and power density for AI data centers and critical energy infrastructure. • Sibelco North America will receive up to $56 million to develop next-generation purification for ultra-high-purity quartz used in the semiconductor supply chain. Sibelco North America, part of Belgium parent Sibelco, said the funding for key quartz components in semiconductor manufacturing will be used for next-generation leaching technologies and a demonstration facility to support testing new products in North Carolina. Sibelco CEO Hilmar Rode said announcement "represents a significant step for Sibelco and reflects the importance of high purity quartz within the semiconductor manufacturing supply chain"

item.title: UDPATE 1 Cricket-England's Brook hits record ODI double ton but Sri Lanka pull off epic chase
item.description: England's Harry Brook smashed the fastest double-century in One-Day International history and became the first Englishman to score 200 in the format but Sri Lanka sealed a two-wicket win in their tri-series clash with one ball to spare on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: England's Harry Brook smashed the fastest double-century in One-Day International history and became the first Englishman to score 200 in the format but Sri Lanka sealed a two-wicket win in their tri-series clash with one ball to spare on Thursday. The 27-year-old captain rewrote the record books by racing to his double hundred in 114 balls, surpassing the previous mark of 117 deliveries set by India's Shubman Gill. In the process, Brook also eclipsed England's highest individual ODI score of 182, held by all-rounder Ben Stokes. Brook's scintillating performance ended with the final ball of England's innings when he was caught by Sahan Arachchige off the bowling of Janith Liyanage. He made 202 from 116 deliveries, peppering the Sri Lanka attack with 21 fours and 10 sixes before departing to warm applause from the crowd. The defeat leaves England bottom of the standings after losing both their matches, with Brook saying they need to win their next two games to reach the final in Lahore. "Unfortunately, it (the record) doesn't matter now. I thought we were going to be in a good position but, unfortunately, it doesn't even count," Brook said. "Heart-breaking. I think you've hit the nail on the head there. It's very disappointing that we haven't been able to defend 430, but that's life, that's cricket," he added. "You don't see many teams chase down 430 and hats off to Sri Lanka. They've played exceptionally well. We couldn't execute our skills enough with the ball and, again, they've just played an absolute blinder there ... "We'll have a good chat about it now and over the next couple of days. We've got a good opportunity in the next couple of games to really try and get to that final in Lahore." Joe Root provided strong support with 69 off 66 balls as England piled up 429-4. But the total proved insufficient as Sri Lanka completed the second-highest successful run chase in ODI history. Pavan Rathnayake top-scored with 130 from 106 deliveries, while opener Avishka Fernando and Dasun Shanaka both fell three runs short of centuries. Needing six runs from the final two deliveries, Sri Lanka sealed victory when Liyanage launched Josh Tongue over long-off for six, leaving Brook's record-breaking innings all in vain. Tongue was England's most successful bowler with 3-79. England lost by 87 runs at the same venue in Rawalpindi on Tuesday to Pakistan, who lead the table with two wins from two.

item.title: Ebola patient in Nigeria believed to have contracted disease in Uganda, Switzerland says
item.description: The Ebola patient in Nigeria, the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja, is believed to have contracted the disease while travelling in Uganda, a Swiss government statement to Reuters said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Clement Bonnerot, Anait Miridzhanian, Robbie Corey-Boulet
item.content:encoded: The Ebola patient in Nigeria, the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja, is believed to have contracted the disease while travelling in Uganda, a Swiss government statement to Reuters said on Thursday. Nigeria reported the case, its first Ebola case in more than a decade, on Tuesday, becoming the fourth African country and the most populous yet to be affected by an outbreak that was announced in Democratic Republic of Congo in mid-May and has since become the [USN:L6N4421DF TEXT:"fastest-spreading"] on record. Ugandan authorities have said the woman who fell ill in Nigeria had travelled to eastern Congo before transiting through Uganda. But the World Health Organization and Africa's top health agency said on Thursday they had not received confirmed information that the woman had travelled to Congo. The woman "has been in a private clinic in Abuja for around a week with symptoms. She is believed to have contracted the virus whilst travelling to Uganda around two weeks ago," said an emailed statement from the Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs. "Her husband is in isolation; he has not shown any symptoms. He was travelling with his wife when she is believed to have contracted Ebola." Uganda reported 20 cases in May and June, mostly imported from Congo, but the World Health Organization declared the country [USN:L6N44N0V1 TEXT:"Ebola-free"] in August. Ugandan government spokesperson Alan Kasujja told Reuters late on Thursday that Uganda had no Ebola cases. "That's a fact. If we did, as has happened before, we'd be the first to say," he said. Asked whether the Ugandan government had proof that the woman had travelled to Congo, Kasujja said, "Like what? A passport stamp? Without infringing on the patient’s rights?" AFRICA CDC, WHO SAY NO INFORMATION THAT PATIENT WENT TO CONGO Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention official Wessam Mankoula said on Thursday that Nigeria and Uganda were sharing information to establish the patient's movements and possible source of exposure. "So far, there is no validated information (that) this case traveled to DRC (Democratic Republic of Congo)," Mankoula told an online press conference. The WHO said information it had received about the case did not include travel outside Uganda. "The facts which we have received is that the patient returned to Abuja on October 3, being away from September 16 in Uganda," WHO representative to Nigeria Pavel Ursu told the press conference. Ursu said the focus in Nigeria was now on containing the viral infection and that the patient remained hospitalised, with her biochemical markers improving. Jean Kaseya, Africa CDC director, told Reuters on Wednesday that the patient had been on a two-week holiday in Uganda. Patrick Otim, a WHO emergency response manager, said on Thursday the source of her infection was still unknown as health authorities were working to piece together her travel history. One issue under investigation is which health facilities the woman visited in Abuja after the onset of her symptoms and before her hospitalisation 48 hours later, Otim said. KENYA TRACES ALL CONTACTS OF FIRST CASE Separately, a senior Kenyan health official said authorities there had now traced all 135 contacts of the country's first Ebola case, which was [USN:L8N45S0GY TEXT:"confirmed on October 6"] and after which a further eight cases have been reported. "We have been able to account for them 100%," health ministry director-general Patrick Amoth said. He said the last contact to be traced was a Ugandan citizen who had arrived in Kenya in early October on the same flight as the index patient but exited by road via the Namanga border post with Tanzania, which meant it took more time to find him. Africa CDC is investigating whether the Kenyan case may have come into contact with the patient being treated in Nigeria, as both travelled from Uganda's Entebbe airport on the same day, Mankoula said. Transmission between the two was one of the possible scenarios being examined, he said. Ebola spreads through direct contact with the bodily fluids of infected people, whether living or dead. The disease can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding. The rare Ebola species behind the current outbreak kills about half of those infected and has no approved treatment or vaccine. So far the outbreak is confirmed to have killed about 4,700 people across the four African countries that have reported cases, according to the Africa CDC.

FAST

Oct 22 : Digital security firm eMudhra is exiting its global business of issuing security certificates for websites including India's tax portal after major browser makers blocked them for vulnerabilities that sparked worldwide cybersecurity concerns. The company announced its decision on Thursday after technology giants including Google , Apple and Microsoft stopped trusting its SSL/TLS certificates, which encrypt data sent between users and websites to keep hackers from intercepting it. The vulnerabilities came to light over the weekend, when an independent cybersecurity researcher found several of eMudhra's main certificates could be attacked. EMudhra's customers range from IT majors Infosys and TCS to government agencies, and its certificates protect sites as important as India's income-tax portal.

"EMudhra's certificates are internationally accepted, and a vulnerability like this has created a trust deficit among the global cybersecurity landscape," said Mredul Sarda, founder of San Francisco-based cybersecurity firm Causal Security. The vulnerability went undetected for the last 18 months and passed two rounds of audits, eMudhra said in its statement. The flaws stemmed from eight keys eMudhra generated in April last year that were mistakenly shortened by its software, making them significantly weaker, co-founder Kaushik Srinivasan told Reuters.     Cryptographic keys are long strings of characters used to encrypt and decrypt data when passed through an algorithm. But eMudhra's keys were small enough to make the encryption easier to break. "A single compromised certificate authority can impersonate any website," said Lukasz Olejnik, independent consultant and visiting senior researcher at the Department of War Studies at King's College London. Browsers quickly blocked the compromised certificates but less frequently updated internet-connected devices could remain exposed. "Millions of older devices may remain at risk for years, or forever, because they will still trust those certificates," Olejnik said. India's Computer Emergency Response Team said on Wednesday some eMudhra intermediate certificates had been compromised. EMudhra said it had withdrawn eight certificates, but maintained its infrastructure was not compromised and that no data was breached. Social media attention had brought disproportionate scrutiny to a business that accounts for just 1 per cent of its revenue, the company said. Investors have reacted sharply, with eMudhra shares down 40 per cent in the two days since the vulnerability was disclosed.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Tesla drops as spending pullback clouds AI, robotics ambitions
item.description: Tesla’s shares slid five per cent in premarket trading on Thursday as the EV maker’s reduced capital spending forecast raised questions about the pace of investment behind Elon Musk’s AI, robotics and ...
item.dc:creator: Reuters Staff
item.content:encoded: Tesla’s shares slid five per cent in premarket trading on Thursday as the EV maker’s reduced capital spending forecast raised questions about the pace of investment behind Elon Musk’s AI, robotics and autonomous-driving ambitions. The company on Wednesday lowered its 2026 capital spending forecast to about US$20 billion from more than $25 billion after spending far less than expected on AI and robotics in the third quarter, which led to a surprise positive free cash flow. The strong position may prove valuable as CEO Musk explores combining Tesla with the far more capital-intensive SpaceX. But “investors are likely to come away with mixed feelings,” J.P.Morgan analysts, led by Rajat Gupta, wrote in a note. “The delay helps near-term cash burn but also suggests delays in investments that matter for fruition of long-term opportunities.” Wednesday’s management commentary suggested spending will be ramped up in 2027 and 2028 as Tesla continues to fund robotaxi, Optimus, AI compute and Terafab milestones, the brokerage said. Tesla’s shares have declined about 14 per cent this year, in contrast to the Nasdaq’s roughly 15 per cent gain. The stock is about 23 per cent below its record intraday high of $498.83, reached in December 2025. Its valuation, however, remains well above peers: Tesla traded at 188.24 times its forward earnings estimates, compared with 6.58 for Ford and 5.16 for General Motors. “The risk is Tesla now enters a period of limbo while investors await news on a potential combination with SpaceX, which ... might face significant regulatory hurdles,” said Russ Mould, investment director at AJ Bell. (Reporting by Joel Jose in Bengaluru; Editing by Joyjeet Das)

item.title: Yen se dispara por preocupación por el petróleo, la IA y Francia
item.description: El yen registró el jueves su mayor subida diaria en casi un mes, porque los inversionistas lo buscaron como refugio ante la inestabilidad de los mercados bursátiles, los altos precios del crudo por la guerra en Oriente Medio y las dudas sobre la rentabilidad futura de la inteligencia artificial (IA).
item.dc:creator: Karen Brettell
item.content:encoded: El yen registró el jueves su mayor subida diaria en casi un mes, porque los inversionistas lo buscaron como refugio ante la inestabilidad de los mercados bursátiles, los altos precios del crudo por la guerra en Oriente Medio y las dudas sobre la rentabilidad futura de la inteligencia artificial (IA). En tanto, el dólar se apreciaba frente al euro, porque la preocupación por los disturbios sociales en Francia y el deterioro de las perspectivas fiscales del país pesaban más que las inquietudes sobre el sector de la IA, que provocaba una caída de las acciones estadounidenses. "La IA está poniendo nerviosa a la gente, al igual que el petróleo (...) y Francia. Es evidente que hay un ligero grado de aversión al riesgo en el mercado", dijo Chris Scicluna, de Daiwa Capital Markets. Los precios del petróleo subieron alrededor de un 3%, a un máximo en cinco meses, después de que nuevos ataques hutíes en Arabia Saudita avivaron el temor a una escalada del conflicto en Oriente Medio y a nuevas interrupciones en el suministro. El yen japonés se apreció un 0,75%, a 156,96 unidades por dólar. Parte de la evolución del yen también podría deberse a que se está acercando al nivel clave de 160 unidades por dólar, lo que se considera que aumenta la probabilidad de una nueva intervención de las autoridades japonesas para apuntalar la moneda. El dólar se debilitó un 0,42% frente al franco suizo, otro refugio tradicional, que cotizaba en 0,821 unidades por dólar. El índice dólar , que mide la cotización de la moneda estadounidense frente a una cesta de seis divisas que incluye al yen y al euro, cayó un 0,08%, a 101,6 unidades, mientras que el euro bajaba un 0,09%, a 1,1222 dólares. La preocupación sobre la capacidad de Francia para gestionar su enorme deuda ha perjudicado a los bonos del Estado francés y ha avivado el temor por otros países muy endeudados de la zona del euro. El diferencial entre los rendimientos de los bonos a 10 años de Francia y Alemania alcanzó los 177,7 puntos básicos el jueves, la mayor diferencia desde 2011.

item.title: Israeli fire kills four people in Gaza, medics say
item.description: Israeli strikes and gunfire killed at least four people in the Gaza Strip in separate incidents on Thursday, health officials in the enclave said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Israeli strikes and gunfire killed at least four people in the Gaza Strip in separate incidents on Thursday, health officials in the enclave said. In Gaza City, a strike on a car killed at least one person, medics said. They earlier said there had been two deaths. A crowd gathered around the burning wreckage, as orange-vested emergency crews sprayed it with water, photos from the scene showed. Other strikes killed a Palestinian man on a bike in the southern city of Khan Younis and a man near Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza, and gunfire killed a woman near the Jabalia refugee camp, in the north, the medics added. Israel's military said it had struck Hamas militants in Khan Younis, Nuseirat and Gaza City, but that it was not aware of the reported incident in Jabalia. The Hamas-led Interior Ministry in Gaza said an Israeli airstrike killed a non-commissioned officer and wounded another officer from the drug control police department after hitting their vehicle while returning from an assignment in Tel al-Hawa neighborhood. Israel, which says the Hamas militant group has been rearming and launching attacks in violation of [USN:L6N45Q023 TEXT:"a year-old ceasefire"], has stepped up strikes on the group in recent weeks. Hamas has denied trying to carry out attacks or rebuild its arsenal and accuses Israel of undermining the Gaza peace deal. Last year's US-brokered ceasefire calls for eventual reconstruction of the territory. But little progress has been made as negotiators have failed to agree terms for Hamas to disarm and Israel to withdraw its troops. Israeli airstrikes have continued. At least 1,500 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza since the ceasefire, according to the territory's health officials, while Israel says four soldiers have been killed. Palestinian authorities say more than 74,000 people have been killed in Israel's assault on Gaza, launched after Hamas-led fighters killed about 1,200 people in southern Israel on October 7, 2023.

Meta shares slide, default insurance hits record as AI spending alarms investors

FAST

Oct 22 : Meta Platforms shares fell more than 7 per cent on Thursday as investors balked at another increase in its annual AI spending forecast and a plan to sell new stock to help pay for it. The cost of insuring the social media giant's debt against default also hit an all-time high, the latest sign that fears over the cost of the AI race were spreading to credit markets. The selloff came despite better-than-expected results and a strong forecast, highlighting growing investor unease over AI spending that is pushing historically cash-rich tech companies to take on debt. That expenditure also pushed the Instagram and Facebook owner to its first cash burn in more than a decade. Investors have already been on edge this month over the mounting AI debt, dumping shares of neoclouds such as CoreWeave and Nebius that are spending several times their revenue on data centers to serve a growing backlog of orders.

Experts have said that the borrowing binge leaves AI companies vulnerable to any sharp drop in demand while saddling them with chips that depreciate within five or six years, forcing another round of spending to stay competitive. Meta on Wednesday increased the lower end of its capex forecast range by $5 billion, to a range of $135 billion to $145 billion. That spending would go towards the company's sweeping plan to put its viral Muse agent at the heart of Meta's AI strategy and turn a technology that has gained traction largely with businesses automating coding into a consumer moneymaker. To help fund the push, Meta will create a new class of non-voting shares called Class C. The company said it could raise hundreds of billions of dollars over several years to fund AI investments, acquisitions and employee compensation, with issuances beginning as early as fall 2026. The filing also noted that the issuances helped avoid debt financing which could adversely affect Meta's credit ratings. On Thursday, Meta's five-year credit default swaps were trading at record highs of 114.79 basis points. However, Shay Boloor, chief market strategist at Futurum Equities, said the move was not necessarily a sign of deteriorating fundamentals. The surge in CDS spreads "could have more to do with banks hedging exposure to Meta's massive AI debt financing than actual default risk," he said. As of Wednesday's close, the stock had gained more than 5 per cent this year. If current losses hold, Meta is set to shed about $114 billion in market value.

Source: Reuters

(Corrects annual percentage yield to 4.4 per cent from 4.2 per cent in paragraph 2 after company revised the figure) By Niket Nishant and Manya Saini Oct 22 : SoFi Technologies on Thursday launched a "tokenized deposit" product that lets customers earn interest on cash set aside for crypto purchases, while offering protections similar to those of a traditional bank deposit. Cash held in a SoFi Earn account will generate 4.4 per cent annual interest and be insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, which protects eligible deposits of up to $250,000 per depositor if a bank fails.

"Too much money in the digital asset ecosystem is sitting idle, leaving massive potential earnings on the table for millions of people," SoFi CEO Anthony Noto told Reuters. The product moves SoFi into a space historically dominated by non-bank crypto firms. In recent years, funds earmarked for crypto trading were often parked in interest-bearing stablecoins, giving investors a way to earn yield while keeping money ready to deploy. That model has come under pressure after the GENIUS Act, signed last year, barred stablecoin issuers from paying interest, creating an opening for banks to offer regulated, interest-bearing alternatives through products such as tokenized deposits. SoFi Earn will also let users buy crypto directly or transfer funds to another platform. "The primary opportunity is with people who already participate in crypto and want that money to keep working and ready to move," Noto said. Traditional financial institutions are developing products to tap the crypto market, arguing that bank-issued alternatives offer greater regulatory oversight than stablecoins issued by non-bank entities. In September, a group of 21 financial institutions including Goldman Sachs, Bank of America, Citi and Deutsche Bank, said they planned to create a company this year to issue a dollar-pegged cryptocurrency in the first half of 2027. "Over the next year or so, you're going to see an inflection point. It is a big effort to move traditional finance on chain, but I think the economic drivers are just so powerful that it's inevitable," said Sam MacPherson, CEO at digital asset finance firm Spark.

item.title: Barril toca máximos de cinco meses ya que ataques de hutíes generan temores por suministro
item.description: Los precios del petróleo subían el jueves alrededor de un 3%, a un máximo de cinco meses, luego de que ataques de los hutíes en Arabia Saudita avivaron la preocupación por posibles nuevas interrupciones en el suministro de energía.
item.dc:creator: Scott Disavino
item.content:encoded: Los precios del petróleo subían el jueves alrededor de un 3%, a un máximo de cinco meses, luego de que ataques de los hutíes en Arabia Saudita avivaron la preocupación por posibles nuevas interrupciones en el suministro de energía. * Los futuros del crudo Brent trepaban 3,51 dólares, o un 3,2%, a 112,33 dólares por barril, a las 1705 GMT, mientras que el crudo estadounidense West Texas Intermediate (WTI) sumaba 2,14 dólares, o un 2,2%, a 99,29 dólares. * Esto llevó al Brent a entrar en terreno de sobrecompra técnica por tercera vez en una semana, situando al contrato en camino a su cierre más alto desde el 4 de mayo. * Saudi Aramco ordenó al personal evacuar su sede en Dhahran, en el golfo Pérsico, cerca de Baréin, reportó Reuters, a medida que se intensificaban los combates entre el mayor exportador de crudo del mundo y los hutíes de Yemen. * Los enfrentamientos entre los hutíes y una coalición liderada por Arabia Saudita, que respalda al gobierno de Yemen reconocido internacionalmente, se han recrudecido desde que el grupo alineado con Irán avanzó hacia el estrecho de Mandeb, un punto crítico para la navegación situado en la entrada del mar Rojo. * "Los informes que indican que las exportaciones de crudo de Oriente Medio superan los niveles previos al conflicto quedan más que compensados por los ataques a buques en el estrecho de Ormuz y las ofensivas hutíes contra Arabia Saudita y su infraestructura petrolera", dijo Tamas Varga, analista de PVM Oil. * Los analistas de Morgan Stanley estimaron en una nota que las exportaciones de crudo de Oriente Medio rondaron los 17 millones de barriles por día la semana pasada. Según datos de Kpler, en los 12 meses anteriores al inicio del conflicto, las exportaciones de crudo de la región promediaron cerca de 18 millones de barriles diarios. * En Estados Unidos, la refinería Valero Energy registró el mayor beneficio trimestral de su historia, superando las expectativas de Wall Street, ya que las interrupciones derivadas del conflicto en Oriente Medio provocaron un fuerte aumento en los márgenes de refinado durante el tercer trimestre.

item.title: India overcome New Zealand fightback to win T20 opener
item.description: India overcame a spirited New Zealand fightback after a blazing start to secure a thrilling four-wicket victory in Christchurch on Thursday and take a 1-0 lead in the five-match T20 series.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India overcame a spirited New Zealand fightback after a blazing start to secure a thrilling four-wicket victory in Christchurch on Thursday and take a 1-0 lead in the five-match T20 series. India survived a mid-innings wobble in a 226-run chase after openers Sanju Samson and Abhishek Sharma laid the platform, with Shreyas Iyer's contribution reviving the chase and Naman Dhir applying the finishing touches to seal victory in 19.4 overs. "When they (openers) click, they set up the game for us and the rest of us try to steady the ship and finish," India captain Iyer said. "He (Dhir) gives us lots of options. I personally feel the calm and composed nature he showed tonight, it was magnificent." Put in to bat, New Zealand made the most of favourable conditions as openers Tim Seifert and Finn Allen set the tone before Glenn Phillips produced a dazzling knock to propel the hosts to 225-4. The total was New Zealand's biggest T20 score against India on home soil, but the visitors completed their highest-ever successful run chase despite a stuttering middle phase. Samson and Abhishek stitched together a 93-run opening stand, with Samson hammering 67 off 33 balls, including eight fours and four sixes, as India surged to 94-1 in the powerplay. New Zealand hit back by removing three batters in quick succession, but Iyer countered with 42 off 28 balls to wrest back the momentum, before a late flourish from Dhir (42 not out)took India over the line. "They (India openers) put us under pressure. Another big powerplay from them. We were not at our best," New Zealand captain Mitchell Santner said. "In the middle, we did well to squeeze them. Tight game and both teams might look at things that could have gone here or there." Seifert and Allen had earlier given New Zealand a solid platform, helping the hosts reach 65-1 in the powerplay, with Allen blasting 45 off 24 balls. Phillips then took charge, producing an unbeaten 82 off 40 deliveries, including eight fours and three sixes, while Bevon Jacobs added 31 before being run out. India's bowlers struggled to contain the scoring, with all five used going at 10 runs an over or more. Bhuvneshwar Kumar, playing his first T20 international in four years after last featuring against New Zealand in 2022, endured an expensive return with figures of 0-49. The second T20 will be played on Saturday in Christchurch.

item.title: Rifts emerge in Libya as eastern parliament backs central bank chief's resignation
item.description: A new contest for control of the central bank in divided Libya could emerge after the eastern-based parliament said on Thursday it approved in principle the resignation of its governor, Naji Issa, and backed a member of the bank's board to replace him on an interim basis.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A new contest for control of the central bank in divided Libya could emerge after the eastern-based parliament said on Thursday it approved in principle the resignation of its governor, Naji Issa, and backed a member of the bank's board to replace him on an interim basis. The House of Representatives's (HoR) spokesperson said parliament backed Fowzi Musbah Abukhzam, the board member, to temporarily fill the role at the central bank. In the western half of the North African country, however, Naji Mukhtar Ali, the first deputy of the High Council of State (HCS), rejected Issa's resignation and told him to stay in his post. Yet the head of HCS, Mohamed Takala, contradicted his first deputy's position, and called on Abukhzam to carry on his duties on an interim basis, in line with the HoR decision, underlining some rifts even among the main Libyan factions. "You are requested to assume your duties and carry out the functions of the Governor of the Central Bank of Libya on an interim basis, pending an agreement with the House of Representatives on the appointment of a Governor for the Central Bank," Takala said in a letter to Abukhzam, which was viewed by Reuters and confirmed by a person at the HCS. The eastern parliament will discuss Issa's resignation in a coming session, its spokesperson wrote on X. In August, Issa submitted his resignation to the two legislative chambers, saying he could not continue in his post but without explaining why, according to two documents seen by Reuters at the time. DIVIDED COUNTRY Libya has been split since 2014 into rival authorities in the west and east that emerged from the turmoil following the fall of Muammar Gaddafi in a NATO-backed uprising in 2011. It is now run by the eastern-based HoR, which was elected in 2014, and the western-based HCS, whose members were drawn from a parliament elected in 2012. After Issa submitted his resignation, both chambers had said he should stay in the position until the issue was discussed. In reaction to Thursday's decision by the eastern parliament, Ali, the HCS first deputy in the west, rejected what he called "the unilateral measures taken by the presidency of the House of Representatives." "You are requested to continue performing your tasks," Ali told Issa in a letter seen by Reuters that was confirmed by a central bank official and an HCS source. Issa took up the post in 2024 when the two legislative chambers agreed on his appointment as a way to end a stand off over control of the central bank. Separately, the central bank said in a statement on its verified Facebook page that it condemned the forced entry of people into its headquarters, violating the governor’s office in his absence. It did not explain the incident, but it said it holds all those involved responsible for any consequences, "foremost among them the Ministry of Defence, given its responsibility for protecting and securing the bank’s headquarters." In a separate incident, masked men tried to [USN:L1N4670MR TEXT:"storm the country's financial oversight agency"] on Wednesday, in what Libya's UN mission called an "unacceptable" attempt to install a senior employee by force.

item.title: ＰＨＰ脆弱性、世界で修正急ぐ 攻撃試行は数百万件に
item.description: [東京／北京 ２２日 ロイター] - 世界各国の企業や政府は２２日、広く利用されているプログラミング言語「ＰＨＰ」で見つ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＰＨＰ脆弱性、世界で修正急ぐ　攻撃試行は数百万件に 10/22 20:42 配信

英機関によるＰＨＰの脆弱性への警告、22日撮影 REUTERS/Toby Melville

[東京／北京 ２２日 ロイター] - 世界各国の企業や政府は２２日、広く利用されているプログラミング言語「ＰＨＰ」で見つかった重大な脆弱性の修正を急いだ。サイバーセキュリティー企業によると、脆弱性の公表後に確認されたハッキングの試みは数百万件に及ぶ。

前日の２１日には、ウェブサイト運営者がＰＨＰを使うシステムの安全確保に追われる中、欧州などの政府が予防措置としてウェブサイトを停止した。ＰＨＰの開発者は、人工知能（ＡＩ）によって発見されるまで何年も潜んでいた脆弱性の緊急修正プログラムを公開、利用者に「直ちに更新する」よう呼びかけた。

世界各国で銀行、航空、鉄道、税務、行政のサービスが緊急停止し、公共・企業システムのＰＨＰへの依存度の高さと、脆弱性が明らかになった後に迅速に修正する難しさを示した。

マイクロソフトのサティア・ナデラ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２２日、ドイツのケルンで開いた同社のイベントで「ＩＴやセキュリティーに携わる全ての人にとって、長い一日、長い夜だったと思う。これほどの事態は長らく見たことがない」と語った。

今回の事態は、安全に保守が可能なデジタルシステム構築の重要性を浮き彫りにしたと述べた。

ベルギーのサイバーセキュリティー企業アイキドウ ・セキュリティーの共同創業者、マデリン・ローレンス氏は「修正プログラムの準備が整う前に脆弱性の詳細が公になり、攻撃が報告されている」と説明。「攻撃に備え企業は更新を急いでいる。まさに時間との競争だ」と語った。

クラウドサービス企業クラウドフレアによると、企業や政府が修正プログラムを適用し、予防措置としてウェブサイトを停止する中、ハッキングの試みは数百万件に急増した。

同社のマシュー・プリンスＣＥＯは２１日夜、「公表前の１０時間に、当社のネットワーク全体で脆弱性を悪用しようとする試みを数千件確認した」とＸに投稿。「公表後４５分で数万件、２時間以内に数十万件に跳ね上がり、今では数百万件に達している」とした。

日本では野村ホールディングス、三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループ、ＡＮＡホールディングス、ＪＲ東日本などが２２日、緊急措置の一環として一部のインターネットサービスを一時停止すると発表した。

東京海上ホールディングスは、グループ会社のウェブサイトを停止したと明らかにした。

財務省と気象庁は安全対策を実施するためオンラインサービスを一部停止し、国税庁もサービスを一時停止した。

予防的な停止措置は、日本でサイバーセキュリティーへの懸念が高まっていることを示している。トレンドＡＩのデータによると、２０２６年１─９月に日本で記録されたサイバーインシデントの件数は、２５年通年を上回った。

フランスの通信大手オレンジは、予防措置として、複数の子会社でＰＨＰを使う一部のウェブサイトやアプリケーションへのアクセスを一時停止したと説明した。

中国のクラウドサービス大手テンセントクラウドは、更新版のＰＨＰを導入するよう顧客に呼びかけたが、広範なウェブサイト停止を求めるには至らなかった。

フィンランドの政府ＩＴサービス機関バルトリは、前日に政府の一般向けウェブサービスを停止した後、夜間もＰＨＰのセキュリティー修正プログラムの適用を続け、予防的なサービス停止を段階的に解除していると説明した。「更新に加えてシステムを慎重にテストする必要があるため、サービスの復旧には数日、場合によっては数週間かかる可能性がある」と声明で述べた。

同機関は、サービス停止は脆弱性の悪用やサイバー侵害によるものではなく、脆弱性が実際に悪用された事例も把握していないと説明した。

アジアの複数の政府は２２日、ＰＨＰの脆弱性に関連するサイバーセキュリティー点検を指示した。

中国の工業情報省は、組織や利用者にシステムを直ちに点検し、安全性が確保された最新のＰＨＰに更新するよう呼びかけた。また、サイバーセキュリティー監視を強化し、必要に応じてアカウント、パスワード、鍵（キー） を変更するよう勧告した。

韓国はハッキング攻撃のリスク増大への懸念を理由に、民間部門のサイバーセキュリティー警戒レベルを引き上げ、緊急対応措置を発動した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：米中間選挙目前、ドル円の行方を読む＝高島修氏 アングル：ロシア、欧州企業への圧力強化、米企業は優遇 アングル：接戦のテキサス上院選は民主に勝機、共和が大量資金投入でてこ入れ 焦点：「ミュトス」登場で米銀はシステム修正に奔走、サービスに影響も コラム：サイバー攻撃のリスク、顧客だけでなく保険業界も動揺 最終更新: 10/22(木) 20:42 ロイター

The breach adds to a growing number of cyberattacks on the healthcare sector, including those on medical device makers Abbott, Stryker, Medtronic and Boston Scientific. item.title: France's Macron tightens curbs on protests, blaming hard left for unrest
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that "illegitimate" protests would be banned in the coming days and blamed "seditious" ultra-left groups and vandals for last weekend's riots and looting.
item.dc:creator: Michel Rose
item.content:encoded: French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that "illegitimate" protests would be banned in the coming days and blamed "seditious" ultra-left groups and vandals for last weekend's [USN:L6N4660DJ TEXT:"riots and looting"]. Speaking after a meeting with intelligence chiefs and senior ministers, [USN:L6N4650JF TEXT:"Macron"] said demonstrations organised by groups such as trade unions would be allowed to go ahead but could be diverted along alternative routes to protect businesses. "Last Saturday we had political and seditious acts by ultra-left groups whose aim is to bring down the Republic," he said. His comments came as authorities across France prepared for fresh protests following some of the country's [USN:L1N4670D4 TEXT:"worst urban unrest in years"]. Justice Minister Gerald Darmanin said he wanted voting rights suspended for people who defy bans on taking part in demonstrations, and restrictions on social media access for people involved in violence, looting or attacks on police. All protests planned for Saturday in Marseille and Lyon, France's second- and third-largest cities, have been banned, local authorities said. Yet [USN:L1N46608H TEXT:"fresh demonstrations"] are already taking shape before what officials fear could be another volatile weekend. France's main student union, UNEF, has called for rallies on Saturday, while the Yellow Vest movement, the anti-establishment force that emerged in 2018, has filed plans for a march through central Paris. Businesses in central Paris have begun boarding up their shop windows in case of violence. Luxury goods group Hermes said [USN:S8N3Z600A TEXT:"it had stepped up security measures"] at its French stores. Organisers of the Art Basel Paris international art collectors fair being held in a central Paris exhibition hall said it would be closed all weekend. Elsewhere, authorities in the northern city of Orleans were bracing for potential unrest as the far-right National Rally was due to hold an annual meeting and unions and left-wing groups planned demonstrations. A student protest called for Thursday in Paris was initially banned but eventually allowed to go ahead, though metro stations in central Paris were nonetheless shuttered by transit authorities in anticipation of unauthorised gatherings. PUBLIC ANGER France was rocked on October 17 by violence on the fringes of nationwide protests, exposing the depth of public anger and raising questions about the security services' ability to keep order. Two people have been arrested over an arson attack on Limoges city hall, French officials and media said. A third consecutive night of local curfews passed without major incidents in areas affected by the violence, offering the government some respite ahead of the weekend. The unrest has laid bare a deeper malaise in France, where soaring energy costs, pressure on household budgets and concerns over deteriorating public services have fuelled growing frustration among workers and younger people. The French political class has also descended into a bitter blame game, with the government accusing [USN:L6N4670XJ TEXT:"far-left"] political groups of stoking the unrest. Highlighting investor unease, the [USN:L6N46814J TEXT:"risk premium"] on French government debt over safe-haven German bonds widened to its highest in 15 years on Thursday, while France's benchmark 10-year bond yield hit 5.14%, its highest level since July 2002.

item.title: ロシアとウクライナ攻撃応酬、ゼレンスキー氏「ロシアはクラスター弾頭使用」
item.description:
Olena Harmash Gleb Bryanski
[キーウ／モスクワ ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Olena Harmash　Gleb Bryanski

[キーウ／モスクワ ２２日 ロイター] - ロシアは２２日未明にかけてキーウを弾道ミサイルで激しく攻撃し、ウクライナはモスクワに向けて数百機の無人機（ドローン）を飛ばした。米国が戦争終結に向けて新たな働きかけを行っているが、両国は攻撃の応酬を続けている。

ウクライナ側は、ロシアが３波にわたり少なくとも２１発の弾道ミサイルを発射したと発表した。ロシア側は、ウクライナが夜間に首都モスクワに向けて無人機６３０機を発射したとしている。

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、ロシアがクラスター弾頭を搭載した弾道ミサイル３発で首都キーウを攻撃したと明らかにした。ゼレンスキー氏によると、こうしたミサイルは目標に接近すると空中で爆発し、直径約４００メートルの範囲に被害を及ぼすよう設計されている。１発がキーウの歴史地区に着弾し、世界遺産「キーウ・ペチェールシク大修道院」の修道院近くが直撃を受けたという。

ベラルーシの国営ベルタ通信によると、双方は戦死者の遺体を交換し、ロシアが２５２人、ウクライナが２５人の遺体を引き渡した。

米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使は今週、ノルウェーの首都オスロでゼレンスキー氏のほか、欧州、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の当局者と会談した後、ロシアのプーチン大統領とサンクトペテルブルクで会談した。

ロシアのウシャコフ大統領補佐官は「米国側は（オスロで）いくつかの新たな変化を感じ取り、われわれに伝えた。しかし、そうした変化はわれわれが十分に満足できるものではない」と述べた。

プーチン氏とウィットコフ氏の会談結果について説明を受けたロシア高官によると、会談は比較的短く、踏み込んだ議論はなかった。ウィットコフ氏はオスロでまとめた一連の提案をプーチン氏に手渡し、検討するよう求めたという。

ロシア大統領府に近い別の関係者によると、米国の提案には、ウクライナがドンバス地域全域をロシアに割譲する見返りに、ＮＡＴＯから将来の安全の保証を受ける案が含まれていた。

＜米特使「プーチン氏は人道主義者」と称賛、ウクライナは反発＞

ゼレンスキー氏は２２日、ウィットコフ氏がロシア訪問中にプーチン氏を「人道主義者」とたたえたことに反発した。ウィットコフ氏は、ウクライナでロシア軍に拘束されていた７４歳の米国人の解放について、プーチン氏に謝意を示していた。

ゼレンスキー氏はＸに「昨夜以降、ロシアの『人道主義者たち』がキーウに３波にわたって弾道ミサイルを発射した」と投稿した。「２１発のミサイルが使われた。残念ながら市内の多数の場所が被弾し、被害を受けた」と述べた。ウクライナの１０以上の地域が攻撃され、２人が死亡、子ども５人を含む３４人が負傷したと明らかにした。

ゼレンスキー氏は、ロシアは引き続きウクライナのエネルギーインフラを標的にしており、１１日以降、重要なエネルギー施設に対する攻撃が１７０件を超えたとしている。

ロシアはオデーサ州の港湾インフラとウクライナ軍が使用する船舶に対し、夜間に「大規模攻撃」を実施したと発表した。

ロシアでは、ウクライナのドローンによりモスクワ近郊で２人が負傷したと、ソビャニン市長が通信アプリ「テレグラム」で明らかにした。ドローンの大半は遠方で撃墜されたという。

ウクライナと国境を接するベルゴロド州では、ウクライナのドローン攻撃で男性１人が死亡、別の１人が負傷したと地元当局者が明らかにした。

A view shows detail of racks for data servers, GPUs and CPUs inside the Nebius AI UK data centre, a new facility hosting NVIDIA and other computer firms, at Ark Data Centres, in Chertsey, Britain, November 6, 2025. REUTERS/Toby Melville

FAST

AMSTERDAM, Oct 22 : AI cloud services firm Nebius on Thursday said it had secured a $3.5 billion financing facility from Citi to fund continued development of its data centres and GPU purchases as it races to expand capacity. The announcement comes against the backdrop of a selloff in shares last week related to AI infrastructure, after bonds issued by rival CoreWeave fell sharply in value. CoreWeave is usually grouped with Nebius as among the top "neocloud" firms that are building data centres specialized for AI. The new Nebius facility matures in 364 days and carries an initial interest rate of 2.75 per cent over the term SOFR benchmark rate. The Amsterdam-based company said the financing would give it greater flexibility over the timing and structure of further fundraising to support growth in 2027 and beyond. Its funding sources also include customer prepayments and operating cash flow. Chief Operating Officer Ophir Nave said Nebius had other financing options available, including borrowing against more than $40 billion in long-term contracts with investment-grade customers, which include Microsoft and Meta . "This facility provides additional financing to support our near-term capacity build-out," Nave said in a statement. The company has around $10 billion in convertible bond debt outstanding following a $5.75 billion issue in August.

Source: Reuters

item.title: スポティファイ、予想上回る第4四半期営業益見込む ＡＩ機能で
item.description: [２２日 ロイター] - スウェーデンの音楽配信大手スポティファイは２２日、第４・四半期の営業利益が８億２０００万ユー...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
スポティファイ、予想上回る第4四半期営業益見込む　ＡＩ機能で 10/22 19:55 配信

スポティファイのロゴ、ニューヨーク証券取引所のフロアで2023年撮影 REUTERS/Brendan McDermid

[２２日 ロイター] - スウェーデンの音楽配信大手スポティファイは２２日、第４・四半期の営業利益が８億２０００万ユーロ（９億２０５３万ドル）になるとの見通しを示し、アナリスト予想の８億１３４０万ユーロを上回った。人工知能（ＡＩ）を活用した機能を背景に、ホリデーシーズンにおけるユーザー数の拡大を見込んでいる。

同社の株価はプレマーケット取引で３％以上上昇した。

スポティファイは、音声コメント付きのパーソナライズされた音楽ミックスをキュレートする「AI DJ」や、ユーザーが気分や好みの音楽を説明することで、それに合わせた選曲を生成するプロンプトベースのプレイリストなど、ＡＩを活用した機能を提供。ＡＩへの投資を進めているため、投資家は同社の収益性を注視している。

第３・四半期の営業利益は６億７２００万ユーロと、アナリスト予想の６億７１８０万ユーロとほぼ一致。売上高は４９億７０００万ユーロで、予想は４９億８０００万ユーロだった。

同社は、成長が持続的に加速する強固なビジネスを構築しているとして、「今後もさらなる成長の余地がある」と述べた。

第４・四半期における月間アクティブユーザー数（ＭＡＵ）見通しは８億１８００万人。市場予想の８億１９００万人をわずかに下回った一方、プレミアム加入者数が１０００万人増加して３億１６００万人に達するという見通しは、予想の３億１４７０万人を上回った。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず 最終更新: 10/22(木) 20:01 ロイター

item.title: França relata primeiro caso humano do vírus Shamonda após morte de paciente
item.description: A França relatou nesta quinta-feira o primeiro caso humano do vírus Shamonda, normalmente encontrado em animais de criação, em um paciente que morreu no hospital, embora autoridades tenham afirmado que não há risco para a população em geral.
item.dc:creator: Sybille de La Hamaide, Gus Trompiz
item.content:encoded: A França relatou nesta quinta-feira o primeiro caso humano do vírus Shamonda, normalmente encontrado em animais de criação, em um paciente que morreu no hospital, embora autoridades tenham afirmado que não há risco para a população em geral. O homem estava hospitalizado em Lyon devido a uma doença grave não relacionada, informou um representante do Ministério da Saúde da França a jornalistas. A vítima tinha cerca de 60 anos e morava na região de Lyon, noticiou o jornal local Le Progrès. A Organização Mundial da Saúde (OMS) informou que está em contato com as autoridades francesas a respeito do assunto. "Com base nas informações atuais e no conhecimento sobre a transmissão de vírus intimamente relacionados, trata-se de um caso humano isolado; é improvável que isso leve a uma propagação mais ampla neste momento", afirmou a OMS, sediada em Genebra, que coordena respostas a questões e emergências de saúde pública em nível internacional. "Estamos, claramente, diante de um caso sem precedentes do ponto de vista científico e virológico. Ele está associado ao sistema imunológico severamente debilitado desse homem", explicou Gregory Emery, diretor-geral de saúde da França, a jornalistas. "Do ponto de vista médico e de saúde pública, não há motivo para alerta nem crise", acrescentou. VÍRUS EM ANIMAIS NA EUROPA Transmitido por mosquitos picadores e mais comumente encontrado em bovinos, o vírus Shamonda também já foi detectado em cavalos, alpacas, ovelhas e cabras, informou a Organização Mundial de Saúde Animal (WOAH, na sigla em inglês). Não há relato de transmissão de gado para humanos ou de humano para humano, disse Emery. Atualmente, não há vacinas comercialmente disponíveis contra o vírus Shamonda, informou a WOAH. Identificado na Nigéria em meados da década de 1960, o vírus Shamonda foi confirmado pela primeira vez na Europa no final de julho, após testes genômicos em bovinos doentes no sul da Alemanha, na Suíça e no leste da França. Um relatório do boletim semanal de vigilância sanitária animal da França indicou que o vírus também havia sido detectado na Áustria, Bélgica, Irlanda, Itália, Liechtenstein, Luxemburgo, Holanda, Portugal, Eslovênia, Espanha e na ilha de Jersey, no Reino Unido. O vírus provoca diversos efeitos nos animais. O gado infectado apresenta diarreia, fraqueza, perda de apetite e, com menos frequência, febre, informaram as autoridades francesas de saúde animal. Um estudo realizado em nove fazendas leiteiras francesas constatou que a produção de leite caiu em até 75% nos rebanhos afetados.

Oct 22 : Tesla's shares fell 2 per cent on Thursday after the EV maker cut its capital spending forecast, raising concerns among investors counting on heavy investment for Elon Musk's AI and robotics vision. The company on Wednesday lowered its 2026 capital spending forecast to about $20 billion from more than $25 billion after spending far less than expected on AI and robotics in the third quarter, which led to a surprise positive free cash flow. The strong position may prove valuable as CEO Musk explores combining Tesla with the far more capital-intensive SpaceX. Capex is a delicate balance in this market, said Josh Gilbert, lead analyst at etoro. Investors welcome a larger budget if they can see returns, but a smaller one hints at slowing growth, he added.

"For a stock priced on Cybercab and Optimus, that (capex forecast cut) explains why the shares went nowhere on a result that beat on most measures." Tesla did not break down the areas that would see spending cuts and the leadership on Wednesday attributed the adjustment to managing capital deployment efficiently. Tesla's shares have declined about 14 per cent this year, in contrast to the Nasdaq's roughly 15 per cent gain. The stock is about 23 per cent below its record intraday high of $498.83, reached in December. Its valuation, however, remains well above peers: Tesla traded at 188.24 times its forward earnings estimates, compared with 6.58 for Ford and 5.16 for General Motors. Tesla and SpaceX have formed special committees to discuss a potential mega-merger, Musk said on Tuesday. The move could create an AI, cars, satellites and rockets behemoth worth about $3.5 trillion. "The risk is Tesla now enters a period of limbo while investors await news on a potential combination with SpaceX, which ... might face significant regulatory hurdles," said Russ Mould, investment director at AJ Bell.

item.title: 中国恒大集団の清算人、2年半で債権の回収1％どまり
item.description: [香港 ２２日 ロイター] - 破綻した中国不動産開発業者、中国恒大集団の清算人は２２日、２０２４年１月に香港の裁判所...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国恒大集団の清算人、2年半で債権の回収1％どまり 10/22 19:50 配信

中国恒大のロゴ、香港で2021年撮影 REUTERS/Tyrone Siu/File Photo

[香港 ２２日 ロイター] - 破綻した中国不動産開発業者、中国恒大集団の清算人は２２日、２０２４年１月に香港の裁判所が清算を命じて以来２回目となる進捗報告書を公表し、これまでの資産売却や貸付金回収を通じて４億３５９０万ドルを回収したと明らかにした。ただ、同社に対して約４６０億ドルの債権を保有する債権者への返済がいかに困難であるかが浮き彫りになっている。

清算人は、２７年上半期に債権者への第１回中間配当を目指すとしているが、その額は未定だ。

かつて中国最大の不動産開発業者だった同社は、約３０００億ドルの負債の大部分について債務不履行に陥り、中国不動産危機の象徴となった。

香港本社で発見された１０７点の美術品のうち９６点が２８８０万ドルで売却されたが、損失を伴うものだったという。このコレクションには、ピカソ、モネ、ウォーホルの作品に加え、ムーアやヘップワースの彫刻も含まれていた。

第４・四半期にはプライベートジェットも売却対象となっており、約１２００万ドルでの売却が見込まれている。また、清算人は、２０年に行われた寄付金の一部について、米国の大学に対し２００万ドルの返還を求めている。

業界の専門家らは、会社の規模と複雑さを考慮すると、恒大集団の清算が完了するまでには１０年以上かかる可能性があると指摘している。
